moscow3-ua157a2c9b2e93c14cb-1.text: In accordance with Federal Law of 27 May 2003 No. 58-ФЗ ‘On the System of State Service of the Russian Federation’ and Federal Law of 27 July 2004 No. 79-ФЗ ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, this Law regulates the organization of the state civil service of the City of Moscow and relations connected with entry into, performance of and termination of the state civil service of the City of Moscow.

moscow3-ub7fef20bd3258b2992-1.text: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law
moscow3-ub7fef20bd3258b2992-1.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law

moscow3-u627ce9ffa28bea7c03-1.text: 1. State bodies of the City of Moscow (hereinafter referred to as state bodies) are the bodies of state power of the City of Moscow and their staff offices, and other state bodies established in accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal laws, the Charter of the City of Moscow and other laws of the City of Moscow.
moscow3-u627ce9ffa28bea7c03-1.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law

moscow3-ud66ec826807cc01c3b-1.text: 2. The employer of a state civil servant of the City of Moscow is the City of Moscow as a constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
moscow3-ud66ec826807cc01c3b-1.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law

moscow3-ud186e59a88824324a0-1.text: 3. The employer’s representative is the head of a state body or a person holding a state office of the City of Moscow who exercises the employer’s powers on behalf of the City of Moscow, or a representative of that head or person.
moscow3-ud186e59a88824324a0-1.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law

moscow3-u76df43ce55895bbceb-1.text: For civil servants holding state civil service positions of the City of Moscow (hereinafter referred to as civil service positions) in the Staff Office of the legislative body of the City of Moscow — the Moscow City Duma — the employer’s representative is the Head of the Staff Office of the Moscow City Duma.
moscow3-u76df43ce55895bbceb-1.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law

moscow3-ud0c03a121b54698586-1.text: For civil servants holding positions as heads and deputy heads of executive authorities of the City of Moscow, or heads and deputy heads of structural subdivisions of the Staff Office of the Mayor and Government of Moscow, the employer’s representative is the highest official of the City of Moscow who heads the Government of Moscow or, by that official’s decision, a member of the Government of Moscow or another head of an executive authority of the City of Moscow.
moscow3-ud0c03a121b54698586-1.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law

moscow3-u3d6af329707aa1b946-1.text: 4. A state civil servant of the City of Moscow (hereinafter referred to as a civil servant) is a citizen of the Russian Federation who has undertaken obligations to perform the state civil service of the City of Moscow. A civil servant carries out professional service activities in a civil service position in accordance with a state body’s act of appointment to a civil service position and a service contract, and receives monetary remuneration from the federal budget or the budget of the City of Moscow.
moscow3-u3d6af329707aa1b946-1.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law

moscow3-u818b165817796f4a83-1.text: 5. State offices of the City of Moscow are offices established by the Charter of the City of Moscow and laws of the City of Moscow for the direct exercise of the powers of state bodies.
moscow3-u818b165817796f4a83-1.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law

moscow3-u0369e05d2057ae6113-1.text: 6. Legislation on the state civil service (hereinafter referred to as civil service legislation) is the body of federal laws and other regulatory legal acts, and laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, concerning the state civil service.
moscow3-u0369e05d2057ae6113-1.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law

moscow3-u16ea215279e9507a6f-1.text: 7. An act of a state body is a legal act of a state body or a legal act of the head of a state body.
moscow3-u16ea215279e9507a6f-1.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law

moscow3-u44808101be1453325c-1.text: 8. Professional level is the level of knowledge and skills, necessary for performing official duties, of a citizen of the Russian Federation applying to fill a civil service position or of a civil servant.
moscow3-u44808101be1453325c-1.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law

moscow3-u5e0db854f6c4c1906a-1.text: 9. Other concepts used in this Law have the meanings assigned to them by federal legislation.
moscow3-u5e0db854f6c4c1906a-1.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law

moscow3-u689a0072e6ce54d955-1.text: Article 2. State civil service of the City of Moscow
moscow3-u689a0072e6ce54d955-1.locator: Article 2. State civil service of the City of Moscow

moscow3-uc67b800baedea5a3cc-1.text: 1. The state civil service of the City of Moscow (hereinafter referred to as the civil service) is the professional service activity of citizens of the Russian Federation (hereinafter referred to as citizens) in civil service positions to support the exercise of the powers of state bodies and persons holding state offices of the City of Moscow.
moscow3-uc67b800baedea5a3cc-1.locator: Article 2. State civil service of the City of Moscow

moscow3-u23f6f9e5549b3dac78-1.text: 2. The activities of persons holding state offices of the City of Moscow are not regulated by this Law.
moscow3-u23f6f9e5549b3dac78-1.locator: Article 2. State civil service of the City of Moscow

moscow3-ua66ce41a5f27ac3e28-1.text: Article 3. Principles of the civil service
moscow3-ua66ce41a5f27ac3e28-1.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service

moscow3-ue094ef30bbda9ab40d-1.text: The principles of the civil service are:
moscow3-ue094ef30bbda9ab40d-1.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service

moscow3-uadc69689a2eaa4491d-1.text: 1) unity of the state service system, ensuring compliance with the constitutional division of matters of jurisdiction and powers between federal bodies of state power and bodies of state power of the City of Moscow; 2) priority of human and civil rights and freedoms;
moscow3-uadc69689a2eaa4491d-1.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service

moscow3-u79707a86525eec5550-1.text: 3) unity of the legal and organizational foundations of the federal civil service and the civil service of the City of Moscow;
moscow3-u79707a86525eec5550-1.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service

moscow3-u6e0b4828e200870eb6-1.text: 4) equal access to the civil service for citizens proficient in the state language of the Russian Federation, and equal conditions of service irrespective of sex, race, ethnicity, origin, property and official status, place of residence, attitude to religion, beliefs, membership of public associations, or other circumstances unrelated to a civil servant’s professional qualities;
moscow3-u6e0b4828e200870eb6-1.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service

moscow3-uf911568d2ff060cf0b-1.text: 5) professionalism and competence of civil servants;
moscow3-uf911568d2ff060cf0b-1.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service

moscow3-ufb6c8853e225ba81dd-1.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service

moscow3-uf40c29536f58c1a5b8-1.text: 7) openness of the civil service and its accessibility to public oversight, and objective information to the public about the activities of state servants;
moscow3-uf40c29536f58c1a5b8-1.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service

moscow3-ude8014bc716b3c751f-1.text: 8) interaction with public associations and citizens;
moscow3-ude8014bc716b3c751f-1.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service

moscow3-uc4494f3981fc12b099-1.text: 9) protection of civil servants against unlawful interference in their professional service activities;
moscow3-uc4494f3981fc12b099-1.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service

moscow3-ubf6c79aa29a5f639f5-1.text: 10) legal and social protection of civil servants.
moscow3-ubf6c79aa29a5f639f5-1.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service

moscow3-u631d4c6ea1b1dc514c-1.text: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service
moscow3-u631d4c6ea1b1dc514c-1.locator: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service

moscow3-uf6fb66b2bf67932ecb-1.text: 1. The legal framework for regulating the civil service consists of:
moscow3-uf6fb66b2bf67932ecb-1.locator: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service

moscow3-u8ea61d4b070215f568-1.text: 1) the Constitution of the Russian Federation;
moscow3-u8ea61d4b070215f568-1.locator: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service

moscow3-u04b1b3a95baee54b79-1.locator: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service

moscow3-u350fb889a593686b28-1.text: 3) federal laws and other regulatory legal acts; 4) the Charter of the City of Moscow;
moscow3-u350fb889a593686b28-1.locator: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service

moscow3-u11a0a6fbf3f8d75553-1.text: 5) this Law and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow.
moscow3-u11a0a6fbf3f8d75553-1.locator: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service

moscow3-u9e5001863e323d3fa8-1.text: 2. Federal laws and other regulatory legal acts, and laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, containing labour-law rules apply to relations connected with the civil service insofar as those relations are not regulated by civil service legislation.
moscow3-u9e5001863e323d3fa8-1.locator: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service

moscow3-u8408600a442f15a2b4-1.text: Civil service positions are established by laws or other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow to support the exercise of the powers of a state body or a person holding a state office of the City of Moscow.

moscow3-udb76ec44b26e65ea16-1.text: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
moscow3-udb76ec44b26e65ea16-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-u58f26cb3441ceb90cc-1.text: 1. Civil service positions are divided into categories and groups.
moscow3-u58f26cb3441ceb90cc-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-u11352133b652ae3066-1.text: 2. Civil service positions are divided into the following categories:
moscow3-u11352133b652ae3066-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-u38f433fbf0721f2086-1.text: 1) managers — positions of heads and deputy heads of state bodies and structural subdivisions of state bodies, filled for a fixed term of office or without a limit on the term of office;
moscow3-u38f433fbf0721f2086-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-u1caca6e3077ba4fadf-1.text: 2) assistants (advisers) — positions established to assist persons holding state offices of the City of Moscow and heads of state bodies whose terms of office are limited in exercising their powers, and filled for a fixed period limited to the term of office of those persons or heads;
moscow3-u1caca6e3077ba4fadf-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-uaa658bfa952273b36d-1.text: 3) specialists — positions established to provide professional support for the performance of a state body’s assigned tasks and functions, and filled without a limit on the term of office or for a fixed term of office in cases established by federal laws and this Law;
moscow3-uaa658bfa952273b36d-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-ue86766dea9d9aeb942-1.text: 4) support specialists — positions established to provide organizational, information, documentation, financial and economic, logistical and other support for the activities of a state body, and filled without a limit on the term of office or for a fixed term of office in cases established by federal laws and this Law.
moscow3-ue86766dea9d9aeb942-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-u24c8e97cebb1509e04-1.text: 3. Depending on the nature of the functions performed in a state body, positions may be assigned to the ‘specialists’ or ‘support specialists’ categories by decision of the employer’s representative.
moscow3-u24c8e97cebb1509e04-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-u2819ae19cfada23f53-1.text: 4. Civil service positions are divided into the following groups:
moscow3-u2819ae19cfada23f53-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-uf5706e5bb5fc4d7012-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-u6a83f088a682a21848-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-u3b5abfdd2132526455-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-u04877996d1021f1522-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-u7e3c2f629dbbb2eb29-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-u90e008f4e5c0af0fab-1.text: 5. Civil service positions in the ‘managers’ and ‘assistants (advisers)’ categories are divided into the highest, principal and leading groups of civil service positions in accordance with the Register of State Civil Service Positions of the City of Moscow.
moscow3-u90e008f4e5c0af0fab-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-u3f18e7b77dcd1e3d97-1.text: 6. Civil service positions in the ‘specialists’ category are divided into the highest, principal, leading and senior groups of civil service positions in accordance with the Register of State Civil Service Positions of the City of Moscow.
moscow3-u3f18e7b77dcd1e3d97-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-u3456cea61397b020f3-1.text: 7. Civil service positions in the ‘support specialists’ category are divided into the principal, leading, senior and junior groups of civil service positions in accordance with the Register of State Civil Service Positions of the City of Moscow.
moscow3-u3456cea61397b020f3-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-ue698c52984840829a9-1.text: 8. The correspondence between civil service positions of the City of Moscow and federal state civil service positions is determined in accordance with a federal law or a decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
moscow3-ue698c52984840829a9-1.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions

moscow3-ub9ce1a86e093d06f5c-1.text: Article 7. Register of state civil service positions of the City of Moscow
moscow3-ub9ce1a86e093d06f5c-1.locator: Article 7. Register of state civil service positions of the City of Moscow

moscow3-u38a071bfe13ec576ac-1.text: 1. Civil service positions classified by state body, category and group form the Register of State Civil Service Positions of the City of Moscow.
moscow3-u38a071bfe13ec576ac-1.locator: Article 7. Register of state civil service positions of the City of Moscow

moscow3-udac9e3554fbc30df7d-1.text: 2. The Register of State Civil Service Positions of the City of Moscow is approved by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow in accordance with this Law and the structure of state bodies, and taking account of the Register of Federal State Civil Service Positions.
moscow3-udac9e3554fbc30df7d-1.locator: Article 7. Register of state civil service positions of the City of Moscow

moscow3-u60c3bdf736ffbde8f1-1.text: 3. This part was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24.
moscow3-u60c3bdf736ffbde8f1-1.locator: Article 7. Register of state civil service positions of the City of Moscow

moscow3-uc90442caa38061152c-1.text: 1. Civil service class ranks are conferred on civil servants in accordance with federal legislation and this Article.

moscow3-ua01e26d1cc887d5251-1.text: 2. This part was repealed with effect from 29 April 2023 by Law of the City of Moscow of 19 April 2023 No. 10.

moscow3-udd8b43ff5dec0a51a3-1.text: 3. This part was repealed with effect from 24 December 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 30 November 2011 No. 57.

moscow3-u1e2dcff318458cca62-1.text: 4. Civil servants holding civil service positions assigned to the highest group of civil service positions are conferred the civil service class ranks of Active State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class.

moscow3-ubc476d0a165ed89b6c-1.text: 5. Civil servants holding civil service positions assigned to the principal group of civil service positions are conferred the civil service class ranks of State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class.

moscow3-u76ea6a7521cf2928cd-1.text: 6. Civil servants holding civil service positions assigned to the leading group of civil service positions are conferred the civil service class ranks of State Civil Service Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class.

moscow3-uf6063e62465e18c7f7-1.text: 7. Civil servants holding civil service positions assigned to the senior group of civil service positions are conferred the civil service class ranks of State Civil Service Referent of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class.

moscow3-ue5136e1afaf9f261b3-1.text: 8. Civil servants holding civil service positions assigned to the junior group of civil service positions are conferred the civil service class ranks of State Civil Service Secretary of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class.

moscow3-u65b1580cd7ef745cb3-1.text: 9. The civil service class ranks of Active State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, are conferred by the Mayor of Moscow.

moscow3-ude41473dffb7a4486a-1.text: 10. In the Staff Office of the Mayor and Government of Moscow and in the executive authorities of the City of Moscow, the civil service class ranks of State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, are conferred by the Mayor of Moscow. In other state bodies, the civil service class ranks of State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, are conferred by the employer’s representative.

moscow3-u8065879e8ebe29ac30-1.text: 11. The civil service class ranks of State Civil Service Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, State Civil Service Referent of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, and State Civil Service Secretary of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, are conferred by the employer’s representative.

moscow3-u5d3f04bd4d33a6dac6-1.text: 12. Civil servants entering the civil service for the first time are conferred the minimum class ranks for the respective groups of civil service positions to which their positions belong. These class ranks are conferred after successful completion of probation or, if no probation was set, upon expiry of three months after appointment to a civil service position, except in the cases provided for in part 12.1 of this Article.

moscow3-u6abf78e482ca86515c-1.text: 12.1. A citizen holding a class rank of a municipal servant of an intracity municipal formation in the City of Moscow (hereinafter referred to as a municipal servant) who enters the civil service is conferred a civil service class rank, from the date of appointment to a civil service position, in accordance with the table of correspondence between municipal servants’ class ranks and civil service class ranks:

moscow3-u6c9550d4e9a97b044c-1.text: 13. Entries on the conferral of class ranks are made in civil servants’ personnel files and employment record books (where available).

moscow3-u61d6264d32d773ad3a-1.text: 14. From the date on which class ranks are conferred, civil servants are paid monthly rank salaries corresponding to the civil service class ranks conferred on them.

moscow3-ua4875962dd1b0fe9cf-1.text: 15. Successive class ranks are conferred on civil servants within the respective groups of civil service positions to which their positions belong, subject to expiry of the period established for service in the previous class rank:

moscow3-u60c7954bd04311b5f9-1.text: 1) in the class ranks of State Civil Service Secretary of the City of Moscow, 3rd or 2nd class, or State Civil Service Referent of the City of Moscow, 3rd or 2nd class — at least one year;

moscow3-ua9038233ee6d9cdf2b-1.text: 2) in the class ranks of State Civil Service Councillor of the City of Moscow, 3rd or 2nd class, or State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 3rd or 2nd class — at least two years.

moscow3-u88e5666da9b21b8ab9-1.text: 16. No minimum periods in the class ranks of Active State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 3rd or 2nd class, are established for conferral of the next class rank.

moscow3-u04b203a496fd42cf20-1.text: 17. When civil servants are appointed to civil service positions belonging to higher groups than the positions they previously held, they are conferred the minimum class ranks for the respective groups of civil service positions to which their new positions belong, without observing the sequence of ranks and without taking account of time spent in the previous class rank. These class ranks are conferred after successful completion of probation or, if no probation was set, upon expiry of three months after appointment to a civil service position.

moscow3-u11dfae382da21a7ef5-1.text: 18. For special distinction in the civil service, on the recommendation of the immediate supervisor, a civil servant may be conferred a further class rank:

moscow3-ueef663d937c16f793b-1.text: 1) before expiry of the period established by part 15 of this Article, but no earlier than six months after taking up the civil service position held;

moscow3-u82f9e7024188033424-1.text: 2) upon expiry of the period established by part 15 of this Article, one rank above the class rank corresponding to the civil service position held, within the group of civil service positions to which that position belongs.

moscow3-uf7faa5ca3391297f96-1.text: 19. Civil servants retain the class ranks conferred on them upon release from their civil service positions and dismissal from the civil service.

moscow3-u44bcb628a1651aa58a-1.text: 20. Civil servants may be deprived of the class ranks conferred on them on the grounds and in accordance with the procedure established by federal legislation.

moscow3-ub8f880cda59d0a0ae2-1.text: 21. A further class rank may not be conferred on civil servants suspended from their civil service positions in accordance with Article 29 of this Law.

moscow3-ub31b354a697012a436-1.text: 22. A civil servant who has a disciplinary sanction that has not been lifted in accordance with the established procedure shall not be conferred a further class rank.

moscow3-uc6e408036ba6b05c9a-1.text: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions
moscow3-uc6e408036ba6b05c9a-1.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions

moscow3-u02045bf2ff66330365-1.text: 1. Filling a civil service position requires compliance with qualification requirements concerning the level of professional education and professional level and, where the employer’s representative has made a corresponding decision, the specialty or field of training (broader groups of specialties and fields of training) and the qualification obtained upon completion of an additional professional retraining programme.
moscow3-u02045bf2ff66330365-1.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions

moscow3-u5c1aca23df55a81821-1.text: 2. Qualification requirements for civil service positions are established in accordance with the categories and groups of civil service positions and the field and type of a civil servant's professional service activity.
moscow3-u5c1aca23df55a81821-1.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions

moscow3-u0c8f5d9503ebd5b902-1.text: 3. Holding positions in the ‘managers’, ‘assistants (advisers)’ and ‘specialists’ categories of the highest and principal groups of civil service positions requires higher education at no less than specialist degree or master's degree level.
moscow3-u0c8f5d9503ebd5b902-1.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions

moscow3-uee9d0396df348842cf-1.text: 4. Higher education is mandatory for positions in the ‘managers’ and ‘assistants (advisers)’ categories of the leading group, the ‘specialists’ category of the leading and senior groups, and the ‘support specialists’ category of the principal and leading groups of civil service positions.
moscow3-uee9d0396df348842cf-1.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions

moscow3-u48b12e7d8ac7bd3416-1.text: 4.1. Professional education is mandatory for positions in the ‘support specialists’ category of the senior and junior groups of civil service positions.
moscow3-u48b12e7d8ac7bd3416-1.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions

moscow3-u114a2fd0190fba7476-1.text: 5. No qualification requirements concerning length of civil service or work experience in the specialty or field of training apply to the filling of civil service positions.
moscow3-u114a2fd0190fba7476-1.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions

moscow3-uf74e4b9c1305741337-1.text: 6. This part was repealed with effect from 17 October 2009 by Law of the City of Moscow of 16 September 2009 No. 34.
moscow3-uf74e4b9c1305741337-1.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions

moscow3-u45a75cc7f91b1e9ede-1.text: 7. Qualification requirements concerning professional level are established by a civil servant's official duties regulations according to the category and group of the civil service position and the field and type of professional service activity. A civil servant's official duties regulations (hereinafter official duties regulations) may also prescribe qualification requirements concerning the specialty or field of training (broader groups of specialties and fields of training) and the qualification obtained through an additional professional retraining programme necessary to hold the civil service position.
moscow3-u45a75cc7f91b1e9ede-1.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions

moscow3-u99a5415b95a7bf0789-1.text: 8. Unless otherwise established by federal law, compliance by a citizen applying for a civil service position or by a civil servant with the qualification requirements for that position is checked by the state body’s structural subdivision responsible for state service and personnel matters (hereinafter also referred to as the state body’s personnel service).
moscow3-u99a5415b95a7bf0789-1.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions

moscow3-u1074cbf1be6f1d3838-1.text: 9. To check whether a citizen seeking a civil service position or a civil servant meets the qualification requirements concerning professional level, the state body's personnel service assesses that citizen's or civil servant's professional level for the position. The assessment uses methods not contrary to federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, with the participation of the state body's subdivision in which the position is established. By decision of the head of the state body or a person authorized by that head, scientific, educational and other organizations specializing in the relevant fields and types of civil servants' professional service activity or in personnel technologies and civil service matters, and their representatives, may be involved in the assessment.
moscow3-u1074cbf1be6f1d3838-1.locator: Article 9. Qualification requirements for filling civil service positions

moscow3-u01a08ca87bb85874bf-1.text: Chapter 3. Legal position (status) of a civil servant
moscow3-u01a08ca87bb85874bf-1.locator: Chapter 3. Legal position (status) of a civil servant

moscow3-uaada1fc57c80b4c7e3-1.text: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant
moscow3-uaada1fc57c80b4c7e3-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-uc453a917836e24290c-1.text: 1. A civil servant has the right to:
moscow3-uc453a917836e24290c-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-u28ec39ab46e2301253-1.text: 1) provision of proper organizational and technical conditions necessary for performing official duties;
moscow3-u28ec39ab46e2301253-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-u83d21b8868f9303e65-1.text: 2) familiarization with the official duties regulations and other regulatory legal acts defining their rights and duties in the civil service position held, the criteria for assessing the efficiency of their performance of official duties, the performance indicators of their professional service activities, and the conditions for career advancement;
moscow3-u83d21b8868f9303e65-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-uafce9c915c21d85543-1.text: 3) rest, ensured through normal service hours, days off and non-working public holidays, and annual paid basic and additional leave; 4) monetary remuneration and other payments connected with the performance of official duties in accordance with federal laws and other regulatory legal acts, this Law, decrees of the Mayor of Moscow and the terms of the service contract;
moscow3-uafce9c915c21d85543-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-u764d3934117ca0e4db-1.text: 5) obtaining, in the prescribed manner, information and materials necessary for performing official duties;
moscow3-u764d3934117ca0e4db-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-u9ae15529295407cb25-1.text: 6) making proposals to improve the activities of the state body;
moscow3-u9ae15529295407cb25-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-u37c3648b61cc28406b-1.text: 7) access, in the prescribed manner, to information constituting state secrets if the performance of official duties involves the use of such information;
moscow3-u37c3648b61cc28406b-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-ue1adaf0cbabc8cd7fb-1.text: 8) access, in the prescribed manner in connection with the performance of official duties, to state bodies, local self-government bodies in the City of Moscow (hereinafter referred to as local self-government bodies), public associations and other organizations of the City of Moscow;
moscow3-ue1adaf0cbabc8cd7fb-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-u5f6d177bcb85beb221-1.text: 9) access to appraisals of their professional service activity and other documents before inclusion in their personnel file, access to personnel file materials, and inclusion of their written explanations and other documents and materials in that file;
moscow3-u5f6d177bcb85beb221-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-uc7c712d20911d7497a-1.text: 10) protection of information about the civil servant;
moscow3-uc7c712d20911d7497a-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-u02c87ec682be164e60-1.text: 11) career advancement on a competitive basis;
moscow3-u02c87ec682be164e60-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-ua9d7c61d56c55efa5a-1.text: 12) professional education in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts, this Law and regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow;
moscow3-ua9d7c61d56c55efa5a-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-uf76760eee64b22c3c1-1.text: 13) membership of a trade union; 14) consideration of individual service disputes in accordance with federal laws;
moscow3-uf76760eee64b22c3c1-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-u8e0228fb9167c4d462-1.text: 15) an internal service inquiry at their request;
moscow3-u8e0228fb9167c4d462-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-u98f41944224c95a2fa-1.text: 16) protection of their rights and lawful interests in the civil service, including judicial challenge of violations;
moscow3-u98f41944224c95a2fa-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-u12cc9449b024c6d60a-1.text: 17) medical insurance in accordance with the federal law on medical insurance for state servants of the Russian Federation;
moscow3-u12cc9449b024c6d60a-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-uab7ff3678874fe1beb-1.text: 18) state protection of their life and health, the life and health of their family members, and their property;
moscow3-uab7ff3678874fe1beb-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-uf17ecf1ef117c37d0f-1.text: 19) state pension provision in accordance with federal law.
moscow3-uf17ecf1ef117c37d0f-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-u38853024446a882197-1.text: 2. The duty to ensure a civil servant’s basic rights rests with the employer’s representative.
moscow3-u38853024446a882197-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-ue46e4db955caa5871e-1.text: 3. A civil servant may, after giving prior written notice to the employer’s representative, perform other paid work if this does not give rise to a conflict of interest.
moscow3-ue46e4db955caa5871e-1.locator: Article 10. Basic rights of a civil servant

moscow3-u1516123fe1f2d36e5a-1.text: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant
moscow3-u1516123fe1f2d36e5a-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-uadffb30171f0077120-1.text: 1. A civil servant is obliged to:
moscow3-uadffb30171f0077120-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-u76eae14316b4e9a8b3-1.text: 1) comply with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws and other regulatory legal acts, the Charter of the City of Moscow, and laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, and ensure their implementation;
moscow3-u76eae14316b4e9a8b3-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-u2ae636c2b39dd0667e-1.text: 2) perform official duties in accordance with the official duties regulations;
moscow3-u2ae636c2b39dd0667e-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-u8e632978d08b86ec46-1.text: 3) carry out instructions issued by the relevant managers within their powers;
moscow3-u8e632978d08b86ec46-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-ua776b0112b031c2c44-1.text: 4) respect the rights and lawful interests of citizens and organizations when performing official duties;
moscow3-ua776b0112b031c2c44-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-u328acf174ddf264f8e-1.text: 5) observe the state body's service rules;
moscow3-u328acf174ddf264f8e-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-u016b92ac1e5be7ea24-1.text: 6) maintain the professional level necessary for proper performance of official duties;
moscow3-u016b92ac1e5be7ea24-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-ufdde6d1d3ac4a0c4c6-1.text: 7) not disclose information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal law, or information learned in connection with the performance of official duties, including information concerning citizens' private lives or health or affecting their honour and dignity;
moscow3-ufdde6d1d3ac4a0c4c6-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-u298f449e100e1d6afe-1.text: 8) safeguard state property, including property provided for the performance of official duties;
moscow3-u298f449e100e1d6afe-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-u0f6084b3f2d678170b-1.text: 9) submit, in the prescribed manner, information about themselves and their family members as provided for by federal law; 10) notify the employer’s representative in writing of the termination of Russian Federation citizenship, acquisition of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state, or receipt of a residence permit or other document confirming the citizen’s right of permanent residence in a foreign state, on the day the civil servant learns of this, but no later than five working days from the termination of Russian Federation citizenship, acquisition of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state, or receipt of a residence permit or other document confirming the citizen’s right of permanent residence in a foreign state;
moscow3-u0f6084b3f2d678170b-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-u6cad8efd47fb847660-1.text: 11) observe restrictions, fulfil obligations and requirements for official conduct, and not violate prohibitions established by federal laws;
moscow3-u6cad8efd47fb847660-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-uf8a6a2c50face6c67d-1.text: 12) notify the employer's representative of a personal interest in the performance of official duties that may lead to a conflict of interest, and take measures to prevent such a conflict;
moscow3-uf8a6a2c50face6c67d-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-u2c7cebd5390c71f4c4-1.text: 13) notify the employer’s representative, the prosecutor’s office or other state bodies specified by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation of every approach by any person intended to induce the civil servant to commit corruption offences. The procedure for notifying the employer’s representative of approaches intended to induce a civil servant to commit corruption offences, the information to be included in such notifications, the arrangements for verifying that information and the procedure for registering notifications are determined by the employer’s representative;
moscow3-u2c7cebd5390c71f4c4-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-u7ab7dbba425fd0eede-1.text: 14) notify the employer’s representative in writing of changes that have come to their knowledge in the information contained in the questionnaire provided for by Article 20.3 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, except for information changed by decision of the employer’s representative.
moscow3-u7ab7dbba425fd0eede-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-u17c0836342f9ec9b96-1.text: 1.1. A civil servant is obliged to state monetary values used to value objects of civil rights in accordance with the requirements established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
moscow3-u17c0836342f9ec9b96-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-u777a2779fde2b4817c-1.text: 2. A civil servant may not carry out an unlawful instruction given to them. Upon receiving an instruction from the relevant manager which the civil servant considers unlawful, the civil servant must submit a written explanation of why the instruction is unlawful, specifying the provisions of federal laws and other regulatory legal acts and of laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow which may be violated by carrying it out, and obtain the manager’s written confirmation of the instruction previously given, with a legal justification. If the manager confirms the instruction in writing without a legal justification, the civil servant must refuse to carry it out.
moscow3-u777a2779fde2b4817c-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-u6c10f6868b5d6856a6-1.text: 3. If a civil servant carries out an unlawful instruction, the civil servant and the manager who issued it bear disciplinary, civil, administrative or criminal liability in accordance with federal laws.
moscow3-u6c10f6868b5d6856a6-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-u7161fc10b47d464853-1.text: 4. If a civil servant fails to carry out a lawful instruction, they bear liability in accordance with federal laws.
moscow3-u7161fc10b47d464853-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-ud2cf2cb92fec753f83-1.text: 5. To avoid a conflict of interest, a civil servant holding a position in the ‘managers’ category assigned to the highest group of civil service positions may not represent civil servants’ interests in the elected trade union body of that state body while holding the specified civil service position.
moscow3-ud2cf2cb92fec753f83-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-uad77cfefbe4ec87c68-1.text: 6. Civil servants are subject to compulsory state fingerprint registration in the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by federal law.
moscow3-uad77cfefbe4ec87c68-1.locator: Article 11. Basic duties of a civil servant

moscow3-u65f2803ff60995a136-1.text: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service
moscow3-u65f2803ff60995a136-1.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service

moscow3-uee2a24da7f6f09d89d-1.text: 1. A civil servant may not remain in the civil service in the event of: 1) being declared legally incapable or having limited legal capacity by a court decision that has entered into legal force;
moscow3-uee2a24da7f6f09d89d-1.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u277efd94263e84e9e1-1.text: 2) being sentenced, by a court judgment that has entered into legal force, to a punishment that precludes the performance of official duties in a state service (civil service) position, or having a conviction that has not been expunged or spent in accordance with the procedure established by federal law;
moscow3-u277efd94263e84e9e1-1.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u05e3a423c003edd935-1.text: 3) refusal to undergo the procedure for obtaining access to information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal law, if the duties of the civil service position sought by the citizen or held by the civil servant involve use of such information;
moscow3-u05e3a423c003edd935-1.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u29e663df56b42d8993-1.text: 4) having a disease that prevents entry into or performance of the civil service, confirmed by a medical organization’s conclusion;
moscow3-u29e663df56b42d8993-1.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u7bcf28a01b3aeedc0c-1.text: 5) close kinship or affinity (parents, spouses, children, brothers, sisters, and also spouses’ brothers, sisters, parents and children, and children’s spouses) with a civil servant, where holding the civil service position entails one being directly subordinate or accountable to the other;
moscow3-u7bcf28a01b3aeedc0c-1.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u02a61550a71ad3a1b6-1.text: 6) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation;
moscow3-u02a61550a71ad3a1b6-1.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service

moscow3-udbe55ac70aef51c34e-1.text: 7) holding citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming the citizen’s right of permanent residence in a foreign state, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or federal legislation;
moscow3-udbe55ac70aef51c34e-1.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service

moscow3-uebc37362e6fc5194bb-1.text: 8) submission, upon entry into and/or during civil service, of forged documents and/or knowingly false information purporting to confirm compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements whose violation precludes holding a civil service position, or failure to submit documents and/or information showing noncompliance with such restrictions, prohibitions and requirements;
moscow3-uebc37362e6fc5194bb-1.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u3744579d9f1036e3a0-1.text: 9) failure to submit, in accordance with the procedure established by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow, information on income, property and property-related obligations provided for by Federal Law of 25 December 2008 No. 273-ФЗ ‘On Combating Corruption’ (hereinafter referred to as information on income, property and property-related obligations), and information on expenditure provided for by Federal Law of 3 December 2012 No. 230-ФЗ ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence of Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons to Their Income’ (hereinafter referred to as information on expenditure); submission of knowingly incomplete information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure, except in cases established by federal laws; or submission of knowingly inaccurate information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure; 10) loss of the employer’s representative’s trust in the civil servant in cases of failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption by the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’, other federal laws and this Law.
moscow3-u3744579d9f1036e3a0-1.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u08ab13a411a27132a9-1.text: 11) failure to submit the information provided for by Article 16.2 of this Law.
moscow3-u08ab13a411a27132a9-1.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u3c34f6a2f1adaf1d47-1.text: 12) being found, in accordance with a draft commission’s conclusion, not to have performed conscript military service without lawful grounds for not doing so (except citizens who have performed military service under contract) — for 10 years from the expiry of the period established for appealing that conclusion to the draft commission of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation; or, if that conclusion and/or the decision of the draft commission of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation on the citizen’s appeal against that conclusion was challenged in court, for 10 years from the entry into legal force of the court decision finding that the citizen’s rights were not violated when that conclusion and/or the decision of the draft commission of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation on the citizen’s appeal against that conclusion was issued.
moscow3-u3c34f6a2f1adaf1d47-1.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u44b10e2f31051f5683-1.text: 2. Other restrictions associated with performance of the civil service, and liability for failure to comply with restrictions, are established by federal laws.
moscow3-u44b10e2f31051f5683-1.locator: Article 12. Restrictions associated with the civil service

moscow3-uc3bfd4dc9e7f5c04c1-1.text: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service
moscow3-uc3bfd4dc9e7f5c04c1-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-uad0fcae6aef803ae68-1.text: 1. In connection with civil service, a civil servant is prohibited from:
moscow3-uad0fcae6aef803ae68-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-ue336b3c2819474cf4f-1.text: 1) this point was repealed with effect from 17 July 2015 by Law of the City of Moscow of 24 June 2015 No. 37,;
moscow3-ue336b3c2819474cf4f-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u9535cae58089d34ae2-1.text: 2) holding a civil service position in the event of:
moscow3-u9535cae58089d34ae2-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-ua5781a3b153a64e662-1.text: a) election or appointment to a state office, except in cases established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation;
moscow3-ua5781a3b153a64e662-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u870249a029d79219b9-1.text: б) election to an elected office in a local self-government body;
moscow3-u870249a029d79219b9-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u971c3bbffa55b9e3bf-1.text: в) election to a paid elected office in a trade union body, including an elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a state body;
moscow3-u971c3bbffa55b9e3bf-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u833ce1540a5fc80184-1.text: 3) participating in the management of a commercial or non-commercial organization, except in cases provided for by point 3 of part 1 of Article 17 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’;
moscow3-u833ce1540a5fc80184-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u2db2c1de18fcc744ab-1.text: 3.1) engaging in entrepreneurial activity personally or through agents; 4) acquiring income-yielding securities in cases established by federal law;
moscow3-u2db2c1de18fcc744ab-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u5211611b24226530eb-1.text: 5) acting as an attorney or representative for third parties in the state body in which they hold a civil service position, unless otherwise provided by federal laws;
moscow3-u5211611b24226530eb-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u3e93fc68492176eacf-1.text: 6) receiving rewards from individuals or legal entities in connection with the performance of official duties (gifts, monetary rewards, loans, services, payment for entertainment, recreation or transport expenses, and other rewards). Gifts received by a civil servant in connection with protocol events, official business trips or other official events are recognized as the property of the City of Moscow and must be transferred by the civil servant, under a transfer record, to the state body in which they hold a civil service position, except in cases established by the Civil Code of the Russian Federation. A civil servant who has surrendered a gift received in connection with a protocol event, official business trip or other official event may purchase it in accordance with the procedure established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation;
moscow3-u3e93fc68492176eacf-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u0245538b6027d815d0-1.text: 7) travelling outside the territory of the Russian Federation in connection with the performance of official duties at the expense of individuals or legal entities, except for official business trips undertaken in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation under arrangements between state bodies of the Russian Federation, state bodies of the City of Moscow or local self-government bodies and state or municipal bodies of foreign states, international organizations or foreign organizations;
moscow3-u0245538b6027d815d0-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u4e16e3a1926ba14769-1.text: 8) using material, technical and other support resources or other state property for purposes unrelated to the performance of official duties, or transferring them to other persons;
moscow3-u4e16e3a1926ba14769-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-ua19c4610cf192d748f-1.text: 9) disclosing or using for purposes unrelated to civil service information classified as confidential under federal law, or official information learned in connection with the performance of official duties;
moscow3-ua19c4610cf192d748f-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u709f08d28f39234154-1.text: 10) publicly expressing judgments and assessments, including in the mass media, concerning the activities of state bodies or their heads, including decisions of a superior state body or of the state body in which they hold a civil service position, unless this forms part of their official duties;
moscow3-u709f08d28f39234154-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-ue55e54e645816d9b31-1.text: 11) accepting, without written permission from the employer's representative, awards or honorary and special titles (except academic titles) from foreign States, international organizations, political parties, other public associations or religious associations, if the civil servant's official duties include interaction with those organizations and associations;
moscow3-ue55e54e645816d9b31-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-uac80120a134166c2ee-1.text: 12) using the advantages of official position for election campaigning or campaigning on referendum issues;
moscow3-uac80120a134166c2ee-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u9a39f1507bb0ec5a8a-1.text: 13) using official powers in the interests of political parties, other public associations, religious associations or other organizations, or publicly expressing an attitude towards those associations and organizations in the capacity of a civil servant, unless this forms part of their official duties; 14) establishing structures of political parties, other public associations (except trade unions, veterans’ bodies and other bodies of public self-activity) or religious associations within state bodies, or assisting in the establishment of such structures;
moscow3-u9a39f1507bb0ec5a8a-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u35d6d0f590f8f313fc-1.text: 15) ceasing to perform official duties for the purpose of resolving service disputes;
moscow3-u35d6d0f590f8f313fc-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-ua6bbc2b779a0999b94-1.text: 16) being a member of the governing bodies, boards of trustees, supervisory boards or other bodies of foreign non-profit non-governmental organizations or their structural subdivisions operating in the territory of the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation;
moscow3-ua6bbc2b779a0999b94-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u9b3187a17a33286f61-1.text: 17) engaging, without written permission from the employer’s representative, in paid activity financed exclusively from the funds of foreign states, international and foreign organizations, foreign citizens or stateless persons, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation.
moscow3-u9b3187a17a33286f61-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-ubdec54ade80d3d5f4a-1.text: 1.1. A civil servant holding a civil service position included in a list established by regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, their spouse and their minor children are prohibited from opening or holding accounts (deposits), keeping cash or valuables in foreign banks located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, or owning and/or using foreign financial instruments in the cases provided for by Federal Law of 7 May 2013 No. 79-ФЗ ‘On the Prohibition for Certain Categories of Persons to Open and Hold Accounts (Deposits), Keep Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Own and/or Use Foreign Financial Instruments’.
moscow3-ubdec54ade80d3d5f4a-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u9cc4b2c18562b73735-1.text: 2. Where a civil servant’s ownership of securities (participating interests or shares in the authorized or pooled capital of organizations) gives rise or may give rise to a conflict of interest, the civil servant must transfer the securities (participating interests or shares in the authorized or pooled capital of organizations) that they own into trust management in accordance with the civil legislation of the Russian Federation.
moscow3-u9cc4b2c18562b73735-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u1975326b4a87f51ca4-1.text: 3. After dismissal from the civil service, a citizen may not disclose or use in the interests of organizations or individuals confidential or official information learned in connection with the performance of official duties.
moscow3-u1975326b4a87f51ca4-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u36aae10b80506cd6bd-1.text: 3.1. For two years after dismissal from the civil service, a citizen who held a civil service position included in a list of positions established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow may not, without the consent of the relevant commission on compliance with requirements for the official conduct of state civil servants and the resolution of conflicts of interest (hereinafter referred to as the conflict-of-interest resolution commission), hold positions in an organization under an employment contract and/or perform work (provide services) for that organization under a civil-law contract (civil-law contracts), in cases provided for by federal laws, if certain functions of state administration of that organization formed part of the civil servant’s official (service) duties. The consent of the relevant conflict-of-interest resolution commission is given in accordance with the procedure established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow. Consent of the relevant conflict-of-interest resolution commission is not required where the citizen is appointed to that organization by decision of the President of the Russian Federation.
moscow3-u36aae10b80506cd6bd-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-u79032bff4dea4902db-1.text: 4. Liability for failure to observe the prohibitions provided for by this Article is established by federal laws.
moscow3-u79032bff4dea4902db-1.locator: Article 13. Prohibitions associated with the civil service

moscow3-uf2aa46733dc2bbd75b-1.text: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant
moscow3-uf2aa46733dc2bbd75b-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-uadffb30171f0077120-2.text: 1. A civil servant is obliged to:
moscow3-uadffb30171f0077120-2.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-u276f093b752ab2df76-1.text: 1) perform official duties conscientiously and to a high professional standard;
moscow3-u276f093b752ab2df76-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-u46487beaa30a343b72-1.text: 2) proceed from the principle that recognition, observance and protection of human and civil rights and freedoms determine the meaning and content of their professional service activity;
moscow3-u46487beaa30a343b72-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-u098eee873fcc12e9ab-1.text: 3) carry out professional service activities within the competence of the state body established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts and by laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow;
moscow3-u098eee873fcc12e9ab-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-ucaef5c4ce09d92e6ed-1.text: 4) ensure equal and impartial treatment of all individuals and legal entities, give no preference to any public or religious association, professional or social group, citizen or organization, and avoid bias towards such associations, groups, citizens and organizations;
moscow3-ucaef5c4ce09d92e6ed-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-u468ef8c47c4002ddb4-1.text: 5) refrain from actions influenced by any personal, property-related (financial) or other interests that obstruct conscientious performance of official duties;
moscow3-u468ef8c47c4002ddb4-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-u954fd69dd8d34b6aca-1.text: 6) observe the restrictions established by federal laws for civil servants;
moscow3-u954fd69dd8d34b6aca-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-ued920598caf6958e85-1.text: 7) maintain neutrality, excluding the possibility that decisions of political parties, other public associations, religious associations or other organizations influence their professional service activity;
moscow3-ued920598caf6958e85-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-u92cf2eaeba7c3f976d-1.text: 8) refrain from acts disgracing their honour and dignity;
moscow3-u92cf2eaeba7c3f976d-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-uaaeae581f9995d0cf4-1.text: 9) be courteous in dealings with citizens;
moscow3-uaaeae581f9995d0cf4-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-u1e60ba816627c2a94c-1.text: 10) respect the moral customs and traditions of the peoples of the Russian Federation;
moscow3-u1e60ba816627c2a94c-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-u2c792403646167197e-1.text: 11) take account of the cultural and other characteristics of different ethnic and social groups and religious denominations;
moscow3-u2c792403646167197e-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-ucfcf632528744936a9-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-u2d9995ef1520568e7c-1.text: 13) avoid conflict situations capable of damaging their reputation or the state body's authority;
moscow3-u2d9995ef1520568e7c-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-u4a2c6dda5f659e049e-1.text: 14) observe the established rules for public speaking and provision of official information.
moscow3-u4a2c6dda5f659e049e-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-ue54b22ed78b3372c1d-1.text: 2. A civil servant holding a position in the ‘managers’ category must prevent civil servants from being compelled to participate in the activities of political parties, other public associations or religious associations.
moscow3-ue54b22ed78b3372c1d-1.locator: Article 14. Requirements for the official conduct of a civil servant

moscow3-u3d0d05dcdb5748b737-1.text: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service
moscow3-u3d0d05dcdb5748b737-1.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service

moscow3-u90a0de9b659f8b29ae-1.text: 1. For the purposes of this Law, the concepts of ‘conflict of interest’ and ‘personal interest’ established by Article 10 of the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’ are used.
moscow3-u90a0de9b659f8b29ae-1.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service

moscow3-u7f24f34f1964b79327-1.text: 2. The emergence of personal interests of civil servants that give rise or may give rise to a conflict of interest shall be prevented in order to avoid harm to the lawful interests of citizens, organizations, society and the City of Moscow.
moscow3-u7f24f34f1964b79327-1.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service

moscow3-u5fbf2f5ffb22805b3c-1.text: 3. This part was repealed with effect from 20 February 2016 by Law of the City of Moscow of 27 January 2016 No. 5.
moscow3-u5fbf2f5ffb22805b3c-1.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service

moscow3-u2dc1533bd07d3a1650-1.text: 3.1. Prevention or resolution of a conflict of interest may consist in changing the official or service position of the civil servant who is a party to it, up to suspension from official (service) duties in the prescribed manner, and/or relinquishment by that civil servant of the benefit that caused the conflict of interest.
moscow3-u2dc1533bd07d3a1650-1.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service

moscow3-u67776555479b750e9c-1.text: 3.2. Failure by a civil servant who is a party to a conflict of interest to take measures to prevent or resolve it is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
moscow3-u67776555479b750e9c-1.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service

moscow3-uff9ac4b72ab4de02c9-1.text: 4. An employer’s representative who learns that a civil servant has a personal interest that gives rise or may give rise to a conflict of interest must take measures to prevent or resolve the conflict of interest, up to suspending the civil servant who is a party to the conflict of interest from the civil service position held, in accordance with the procedure established by the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
moscow3-uff9ac4b72ab4de02c9-1.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service

moscow3-u13014494507e00356f-1.text: 4.1. Failure by a civil servant acting as an employer's representative who has learned that a subordinate civil servant has a personal interest causing or potentially causing a conflict of interest to take measures to prevent or resolve it is an offence entailing dismissal of the civil servant acting as the employer's representative from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
moscow3-u13014494507e00356f-1.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service

moscow3-uc00ab693d99365f5d1-1.text: 5. To ensure compliance with requirements for civil servants’ official conduct and the resolution of conflicts of interest, conflict-of-interest resolution commissions shall be established in all state bodies.
moscow3-uc00ab693d99365f5d1-1.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service

moscow3-u3856503967b7cc0f43-1.text: 6. A conflict-of-interest commission is established by a legal act of a state body in the manner determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
moscow3-u3856503967b7cc0f43-1.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service

moscow3-u0d1f6124bc87a193c7-1.text: 7. Conflict-of-interest commissions are formed so as to exclude the possibility of conflicts of interest that could influence their decisions.
moscow3-u0d1f6124bc87a193c7-1.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service

moscow3-ue8094e3cda0ff84de8-1.text: 8. This part was repealed with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7.
moscow3-ue8094e3cda0ff84de8-1.locator: Article 15. Resolving conflicts of interest in the civil service

moscow3-u1ea3534e3e9328a848-1.text: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
moscow3-u1ea3534e3e9328a848-1.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

moscow3-u112b88ce3edbb62a1c-1.text: 1. In the cases established by the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’, information on income, property and property-related obligations shall be submitted to the employer’s representative by:
moscow3-u112b88ce3edbb62a1c-1.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

moscow3-u74e389ad0688536b43-1.text: 1) a citizen seeking a civil service position;
moscow3-u74e389ad0688536b43-1.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

moscow3-ue2d3db635e8151ac35-1.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

moscow3-ue44314e6af7669bb29-1.text: 2. The regulation on the submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations by a civil servant holding a civil service position included in a list established by regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow shall be approved by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow, taking account of the requirements of this Article.
moscow3-ue44314e6af7669bb29-1.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

moscow3-u7d5feba62315f2e542-1.text: 3. Information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article is confidential unless classified as a state secret by federal law.
moscow3-u7d5feba62315f2e542-1.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

moscow3-u7c067e4c7d89463c2f-1.text: 4. Information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article may not be used to establish or determine the solvency of the civil servant, their spouse or minor children, or to collect donations (contributions), directly or indirectly, for the funds of public or religious associations or other organizations, or for individuals.
moscow3-u7c067e4c7d89463c2f-1.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

moscow3-uc6176417f823f053e8-1.text: 5. Persons responsible for disclosing information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article, or for using that information for purposes not provided for by federal laws, bear liability in accordance with federal laws.
moscow3-uc6176417f823f053e8-1.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

moscow3-u1ac298299b210f8f0a-1.text: 6. The accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article are verified in accordance with the procedure established by the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
moscow3-u1ac298299b210f8f0a-1.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

moscow3-u3b32080e22b8c2135d-1.text: 6.1. A civil servant’s failure to submit information on income, property and property-related obligations where its submission is mandatory, or submission of knowingly incomplete information on income, property and property-related obligations, is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
moscow3-u3b32080e22b8c2135d-1.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

moscow3-u7f1003bff1be46a961-1.text: 6.2. A civil servant’s submission of knowingly inaccurate information on income, property and property-related obligations is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service.
moscow3-u7f1003bff1be46a961-1.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

moscow3-u5de8c6e7c129674627-1.text: 7. This part was repealed with effect from 30 March 2026 by Law of the City of Moscow of 25 March 2026 No. 4.
moscow3-u5de8c6e7c129674627-1.locator: Article 16. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations

moscow3-uf876aef68eba116bf2-1.text: Article 16.1. Submission of information on expenditure
moscow3-uf876aef68eba116bf2-1.locator: Article 16.1. Submission of information on expenditure

moscow3-u9cbacbdb0432fea543-1.text: 1. A civil servant holding a civil service position included in a list established by the relevant regulatory legal act of the City of Moscow must submit information on expenditure to the employer’s representative in the cases established by the Federal Law ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence of Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons to Their Income’, in accordance with the procedure established by federal legislation and laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow.
moscow3-u9cbacbdb0432fea543-1.locator: Article 16.1. Submission of information on expenditure

moscow3-u7ab3a09b9222f7c233-1.text: 2. The correspondence of the expenditure of a civil servant, their spouse and their minor children to their income is monitored in accordance with the procedure established by the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’, the Federal Law ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence of Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons to Their Income’, regulatory legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
moscow3-u7ab3a09b9222f7c233-1.locator: Article 16.1. Submission of information on expenditure

moscow3-uad48162af45e3d54fe-1.text: 3. A civil servant’s failure to submit information on expenditure where its submission is mandatory, or submission of knowingly incomplete information on expenditure, is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
moscow3-uad48162af45e3d54fe-1.locator: Article 16.1. Submission of information on expenditure

moscow3-u5ebec0391b937a36dd-1.text: 4. A civil servant’s submission of knowingly inaccurate information on expenditure is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service.
moscow3-u5ebec0391b937a36dd-1.locator: Article 16.1. Submission of information on expenditure

moscow3-u58400ea923da12b8f1-1.text: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-
moscow3-u58400ea923da12b8f1-1.locator: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-

moscow3-uff383afed3f348fbdd-1.locator: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-

moscow3-uaf9ed03e184231db8b-1.text: 1. Information on the addresses of websites and/or website pages on the Internet information and telecommunications network on which a citizen seeking a civil service position or a civil servant has posted publicly accessible information, and data enabling their identification, is submitted to the employer's representative by:
moscow3-uaf9ed03e184231db8b-1.locator: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-

moscow3-u28ca85bf056360ade3-1.text: 1) a citizen seeking a civil service position, upon entry into service, for the three calendar years preceding the year of entry into the civil service;
moscow3-u28ca85bf056360ade3-1.locator: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-

moscow3-u13f6d890914c348377-1.text: 2) a civil servant, annually for the calendar year preceding the year in which the information is submitted, except where publicly accessible information was posted in the performance of the civil servant's official duties.
moscow3-u13f6d890914c348377-1.locator: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-

moscow3-ufcfcc6138bf459f7d2-1.text: 2. The information specified in part 1 of this Article is submitted by citizens seeking civil service positions upon entry into the civil service, and by civil servants no later than 1 April of the year following the reporting year. The information specified in part 1 of this Article is submitted using the form established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
moscow3-ufcfcc6138bf459f7d2-1.locator: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-

moscow3-ubc6f86628770212688-1.text: 3. By decision of the employer's representative, civil servants authorized by that representative process publicly accessible information posted on the Internet information and telecommunications network by applicants for civil service positions and civil servants, and verify the accuracy and completeness of the information provided for by part 1 of this Article.
moscow3-ubc6f86628770212688-1.locator: Article 16.2. Submission of information on the posting of information in information-

moscow3-u6bf1cfbd085b0df3b6-1.text: Chapter 4. Entry into the civil service
moscow3-u6bf1cfbd085b0df3b6-1.locator: Chapter 4. Entry into the civil service

moscow3-u65dd9af80612e1c02b-1.text: Article 17. Right to enter the civil service
moscow3-u65dd9af80612e1c02b-1.locator: Article 17. Right to enter the civil service

moscow3-uee42e8c9ccfe390493-1.text: 1. Citizens of the Russian Federation who have reached the age of 18, are proficient in the state language of the Russian Federation and meet the qualification requirements established by civil service legislation are entitled to enter the civil service.
moscow3-uee42e8c9ccfe390493-1.locator: Article 17. Right to enter the civil service

moscow3-ue10e18a672dccf101e-1.text: 2. This part was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24.
moscow3-ue10e18a672dccf101e-1.locator: Article 17. Right to enter the civil service

moscow3-u2247853281b602f830-1.text: 3. A citizen may not be admitted to the civil service in the cases provided for by points 1-9, 11 and 12 of part 1 of Article 12 of this Law. Other restrictions connected with entry into the civil service are established by federal laws.
moscow3-u2247853281b602f830-1.locator: Article 17. Right to enter the civil service

moscow3-uea16ac839fa8b75fe1-1.text: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
moscow3-uea16ac839fa8b75fe1-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-u2ba8b61c3553c01648-1.text: 1. A citizen’s entry into the civil service to fill a civil service position, or a civil servant’s filling of another civil service position, is based on the results of a competition, unless otherwise established by this Article. A competition to fill a civil service position (hereinafter also referred to as a competition) consists of assessing the professional level of applicants for the position, checking their compliance with the other established qualification requirements for the position, and selecting, on the basis of that assessment and check, a citizen or civil servant from among the applicants for appointment to the civil service position.
moscow3-u2ba8b61c3553c01648-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-u6c0b92f46fcd71b24f-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-ub53feba21a811e7c71-1.text: 1) upon appointment to civil service positions in the ‘managers’ and ‘assistants (advisers)’ categories filled for a fixed term of office; 2) this point was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24,;
moscow3-ub53feba21a811e7c71-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-uace6ca2dce0491e3ad-1.text: 3) when concluding a fixed-term service contract;
moscow3-uace6ca2dce0491e3ad-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-uac735daa25f8324817-1.text: 4) upon appointment by transfer of a civil servant to another civil service position in the cases provided for by points 3-14 of part 5 and points 3-5 of part 6 of Article 25 of this Law;
moscow3-uac735daa25f8324817-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
