moscow3-u842061880ccbad76dc-1.text: 5) upon appointment to a civil service position of a civil servant or citizen included in the civil service personnel reserve formed in accordance with Article 53 of this Law;
moscow3-u842061880ccbad76dc-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-ud43275c19321104851-1.text: 6) in other cases established by federal laws.
moscow3-ud43275c19321104851-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-uc4ada296bac0773bbb-1.text: 3. A competition may be omitted for appointment to particular civil service positions whose duties involve the use of state secrets, according to a list of positions approved by a normative act of the state body.
moscow3-uc4ada296bac0773bbb-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-u8dea90ebacaa4fc633-1.text: 4. By decision of the employer's representative, a competition may be omitted for appointment to positions in the junior group of civil service positions, and in other cases provided for by federal laws.
moscow3-u8dea90ebacaa4fc633-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-u456d772522ff874d0d-1.text: 5. An applicant for a civil service position may be refused admission to the competition because they do not meet the qualification requirements for the vacant civil service position, or because of restrictions established by civil service legislation on entry into and performance of the civil service.
moscow3-u456d772522ff874d0d-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-u6613c85d89638ce7a2-1.text: 6. An applicant for a civil service position who is refused admission to a competition may challenge that decision in accordance with federal legislation.
moscow3-u6613c85d89638ce7a2-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-u3d27955d10c6dfd720-1.text: 7. A competition commission shall be established by an act of the relevant state body to conduct the competition.
moscow3-u3d27955d10c6dfd720-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-ue4bf5fd973c4493151-1.text: 8. The competition commission includes the employer’s representative and/or civil servants authorized by that representative (including from the subdivision responsible for state service and personnel matters and the subdivision in which the competition is being held), as well as independent experts included in the commission in accordance with part 8.2 of Article 22 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’: representatives of scientific, educational and other organizations who are specialists in the relevant fields and types of civil servants’ professional service activities and in personnel technologies and civil service matters. Independent experts must constitute at least one quarter of all members of the competition commission. An independent expert’s term on the competition commission is determined in accordance with federal legislation.
moscow3-ue4bf5fd973c4493151-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-ubb47ce41c1b9305ab8-1.text: 8.1. In an executive authority of the City of Moscow at which a public council has been established in accordance with a legal act of the City of Moscow, the competition commission shall include representatives of that public council in addition to the persons specified in part 8 of this Article. Those representatives and independent experts together must constitute at least one quarter of all members of the competition commission.
moscow3-ubb47ce41c1b9305ab8-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-ub38403b6966a279b5e-1.text: 9. Where a competition is held to fill a civil service position whose official duties involve the use of state secrets, the competition commission shall be formed taking account of the provisions of the legislation of the Russian Federation on state secrets.
moscow3-ub38403b6966a279b5e-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-u3bdab9f85dfc006006-1.text: 10. The competition commission shall be formed so as to exclude the possibility of a conflict of interest that could affect the outcome of decisions taken by the commission.
moscow3-u3bdab9f85dfc006006-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-u1189b87e2c89652056-1.text: 11. An applicant for a civil service position may challenge the competition commission’s decision in accordance with federal legislation.
moscow3-u1189b87e2c89652056-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-ud733a5e75bbc79fafd-1.text: 12. The regulation on competitions, determining the procedure and conditions for conducting them, is established by federal regulatory legal acts.
moscow3-ud733a5e75bbc79fafd-1.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure

moscow3-u3552df7e0bc88e8a35-1.text: Article 19. Concept and parties to a service contract
moscow3-u3552df7e0bc88e8a35-1.locator: Article 19. Concept and parties to a service contract

moscow3-u045da17c55c894e0b5-1.text: 1. A service contract is an agreement between the employer’s representative and a citizen entering the civil service concerning performance of the civil service and holding a civil service position, or between the employer’s representative and a civil servant concerning holding a civil service position. The service contract establishes the rights and duties of the parties.
moscow3-u045da17c55c894e0b5-1.locator: Article 19. Concept and parties to a service contract

moscow3-ud4e2009cafc46acea3-1.text: 2. The employer’s representative undertakes to provide a citizen entering the civil service with the opportunity to perform the civil service, to provide that citizen or civil servant with the opportunity to hold a specified civil service position, to ensure their performance of the civil service and holding of the position in accordance with civil service legislation, to pay the civil servant’s monetary remuneration in full and on time, and to provide state social guarantees.
moscow3-ud4e2009cafc46acea3-1.locator: Article 19. Concept and parties to a service contract

moscow3-ue31fe478416777d325-1.text: 3. A citizen entering the civil service, when concluding a service contract on performance of civil service and holding a civil service position, and a civil servant, when concluding a service contract on holding a civil service position, undertake to perform official duties in accordance with the official duties regulations and observe the state body's service rules.
moscow3-ue31fe478416777d325-1.locator: Article 19. Concept and parties to a service contract

moscow3-ua8646a7204c2be923c-1.text: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
moscow3-ua8646a7204c2be923c-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-u34cc4eb24cb35c419f-1.text: 1. A service contract states its date and place of conclusion; the name of the state body; the employer's representative's position, surname, given name and patronymic (if any); the title, date and number of the legal act determining that representative's legal status and authority to conclude the service contract; the surname, given name and patronymic (if any) of the citizen or civil servant appointed to the civil service position; and details of that person's identity document.
moscow3-u34cc4eb24cb35c419f-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-u9174a18190d45a2dfa-1.text: 2. The terms of a service contract include:
moscow3-u9174a18190d45a2dfa-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-u994037cd72b1490c9f-1.text: 1) the title of the civil service position held, specifying the state body's structural subdivision (if any) and the place of service;
moscow3-u994037cd72b1490c9f-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-u3416ac5dfe99d19753-1.text: 2) the date of commencement of official duties and the duration of the service contract;
moscow3-u3416ac5dfe99d19753-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-ud06f5a16182f7dd359-1.text: 3) the rights, duties and liability of the civil servant provided for in accordance with federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, this Law and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, and the official duties regulations;
moscow3-ud06f5a16182f7dd359-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-ucb76504f58f1a366b0-1.text: 4) the rights, duties and liability of the employer’s representative provided for in accordance with federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, this Law and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow;
moscow3-ucb76504f58f1a366b0-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-u25d462881d5a74c692-1.text: 5) remuneration conditions (the civil servant’s monthly salary for the civil service position held, monthly salary for the civil service class rank conferred, allowances and other payments, including those linked to the results of their professional service activities) established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, this Law and other regulatory legal acts of the City;
moscow3-u25d462881d5a74c692-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-u35e5859604bd806387-1.text: 6) the arrangements for service time and rest time (where these differ for the civil servant from the service rules established in the state body);
moscow3-u35e5859604bd806387-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-ue5374afcafd7f9c55f-1.text: 7) conditions of professional service activity, and compensation and benefits for professional service activity in arduous, harmful and/or dangerous conditions;
moscow3-ue5374afcafd7f9c55f-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-u0c7d76d051f3450e60-1.text: 8) the types and conditions of the civil servant's medical insurance and other types of insurance;
moscow3-u0c7d76d051f3450e60-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-u03bdb04ccf6979d1e4-1.text: 9) types and conditions of social insurance connected with professional service activity;
moscow3-u03bdb04ccf6979d1e4-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-uca8de5a26a891894a1-1.text: 10) inclusion of the position held by the civil servant in the list of civil service positions for which rotation of civil servants is provided; 11) probation, where provided for by Article 24 of this Law;
moscow3-uca8de5a26a891894a1-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-ua9c14390bba4037ba7-1.text: 12) nondisclosure of state secrets, other secrets protected by federal law and official information, if the official duties regulations provide for the use of such information;
moscow3-ua9c14390bba4037ba7-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-u039fb2ada74e39558b-1.text: 13) the person’s obligation, after completing studies at a vocational education organization or higher education organization, to perform civil service for no less than the period established by the targeted education agreement, where the studies were funded from the budget of the City of Moscow;
moscow3-u039fb2ada74e39558b-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-ub3f29146f448077b92-1.text: 14) other terms that do not worsen the civil servant’s position compared with that established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, this Law and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow.
moscow3-ub3f29146f448077b92-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-u6c5cf104543f773de3-1.text: 3. The terms of a service contract may be changed only by agreement of the parties and only in writing.
moscow3-u6c5cf104543f773de3-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-u3182d51f9f115c0be3-1.text: 4. Where a fixed-term service contract is concluded, it states its duration and the circumstances (reasons) that served as the grounds for concluding a fixed-term service contract in accordance with federal laws.
moscow3-u3182d51f9f115c0be3-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-u7b9c35bd6eb814a0ad-1.text: 5. A service contract provides for the parties' liability under the legislation of the Russian Federation for nonperformance or improper performance of the duties and obligations undertaken. A civil servant may not be required to perform official duties not established by the service contract and official duties regulations.
moscow3-u7b9c35bd6eb814a0ad-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-u0ad90e05742b3a355b-1.text: 6. A service contract is concluded in writing in two copies, each signed by the parties. One copy is given to the civil servant and the other is kept in their personnel file. A model service contract form is established by the President of the Russian Federation.
moscow3-u0ad90e05742b3a355b-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-ue8a7f20a5314e02822-1.text: 7. This part was repealed with effect from 14 February 2025 by Law of the City of Moscow of 29 January 2025 No. 9.
moscow3-ue8a7f20a5314e02822-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-u0217e27c20f6a8dc05-1.text: 8. This part was repealed with effect from 14 February 2025 by Law of the City of Moscow of 29 January 2025 No. 9.
moscow3-u0217e27c20f6a8dc05-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-ua31ecfc45147b9c2f8-1.text: 9. This part was repealed with effect from 14 February 2025 by Law of the City of Moscow of 29 January 2025 No. 9.
moscow3-ua31ecfc45147b9c2f8-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-u517817dafc3f96cc64-1.text: 10. This part was repealed with effect from 14 February 2025 by Law of the City of Moscow of 29 January 2025 No. 9.
moscow3-u517817dafc3f96cc64-1.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract

moscow3-uf97b8fa7330dda092a-1.text: Article 21. Term of a service contract
moscow3-uf97b8fa7330dda092a-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-ue1e5bd80a97028c252-1.text: 1. A service contract may be concluded for: 1) an indefinite period;
moscow3-ue1e5bd80a97028c252-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-u5d42d23af1cbd9137f-1.text: 2) a fixed period (hereinafter referred to as a fixed-term service contract).
moscow3-u5d42d23af1cbd9137f-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-uefc7e26aee8135452e-1.text: 2. A fixed-term service contract is concluded for a period of one to five years where civil service relations cannot be established for an indefinite period, taking account of the category of the civil service position held or the conditions of civil service, unless otherwise provided by federal laws.
moscow3-uefc7e26aee8135452e-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-ue8f33854e9302cefb6-1.text: 3. A fixed-term service contract is concluded in the case of:
moscow3-ue8f33854e9302cefb6-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-u2e38f8126436ef54c3-1.text: 1) filling the following civil service positions in the ‘managers’ category:
moscow3-u2e38f8126436ef54c3-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-ua921067b2ad8f85f16-1.text: а) heads and deputy heads of executive authorities of the City of Moscow;
moscow3-ua921067b2ad8f85f16-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-u0ff9f5715017f0c28f-1.text: б) heads and deputy heads of structural subdivisions of the Staff Office of the Mayor and Government of Moscow. The list of civil service positions in the ‘managers’ category in other state bodies that are filled under fixed-term service contracts is approved by the employer’s representative;
moscow3-u0ff9f5715017f0c28f-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-u25358866586c1edbfb-1.text: 2) filling civil service positions in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category;
moscow3-u25358866586c1edbfb-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-ub7a0a63f5da121c683-1.text: 3) filling a civil service position during the absence of a civil servant whose civil service position is retained in accordance with federal laws;
moscow3-ub7a0a63f5da121c683-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-u2d2dbae75466a95341-1.text: 4) holding a civil service position after completion of education by a citizen who concluded a targeted education agreement at a vocational education organization or higher education organization undertaking subsequent civil service;
moscow3-u2d2dbae75466a95341-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-u219b2c25579ed41739-1.text: 5) holding a civil service position in a state body established for a specified period or to perform specified tasks and functions;
moscow3-u219b2c25579ed41739-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-u956295c5948717d71c-1.text: 6) holding a temporary civil service position or filling a position during a civil servant's temporary absence by agreement of the parties to the service contract;
moscow3-u956295c5948717d71c-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-u7dcb1f67ae38deeb71-1.text: 7) filling a civil service position by a civil servant who has reached the maximum age for remaining in the civil service and whose term of service has been extended beyond that age limit in accordance with part 1 of Article 21.1 of this Law;
moscow3-u7dcb1f67ae38deeb71-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-u464aed264eaf4838da-1.text: 8) this point was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24,;
moscow3-u464aed264eaf4838da-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-u4b0e81976a87848e56-1.text: 9) in other cases established by federal laws.
moscow3-u4b0e81976a87848e56-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-uf0fa2006f015017c76-1.text: 4. This part was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24.
moscow3-uf0fa2006f015017c76-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-uba64f94323d5381bf8-1.text: 5. This part was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24.
moscow3-uba64f94323d5381bf8-1.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract

moscow3-u9ae43cf095e3e3d058-1.text: Article 21.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service
moscow3-u9ae43cf095e3e3d058-1.locator: Article 21.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service

moscow3-ubf9eb105fc0e95d473-1.text: 1. The maximum age for remaining in the civil service is 65. For a civil servant who has reached that age limit and holds a civil service position in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category established to assist a person holding a state office of the City of Moscow, the term of civil service may, with the civil servant’s consent and by decision of the employer’s representative, be extended until the end of that person’s term of office. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum age for remaining in the civil service and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the highest group of civil service positions, the term of civil service may, with their consent, be extended (but not beyond the age of 70) by the state body or corresponding official who appointed them. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum age for remaining in the civil service and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the principal group of civil service positions in the Staff Office of the Moscow City Duma, the term of civil service may, with their consent, be extended (but not beyond the age of 70) by the appointing official in agreement with the Chair of the Moscow City Duma. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum age for remaining in the civil service and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the principal group of civil service positions in an executive authority of the City of Moscow, the term of civil service may, with their consent, be extended (but not beyond the age of 70) by the executive authority of the City of Moscow or corresponding official who appointed them, in agreement with the Mayor of Moscow.
moscow3-ubf9eb105fc0e95d473-1.locator: Article 21.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service

moscow3-u1c5010534061d7497a-1.text: 2. Upon reaching the maximum age for remaining in the civil service, by decision of the employer’s representative and with the citizen’s consent, the citizen may continue working in the state body under a fixed-term employment contract in a position that is not a civil service position. .
moscow3-u1c5010534061d7497a-1.locator: Article 21.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service

moscow3-u5852b6bd893f433d4b-1.text: Article 22. Conclusion and entry into force of a service contract
moscow3-u5852b6bd893f433d4b-1.locator: Article 22. Conclusion and entry into force of a service contract

moscow3-u71c1eba1c157065b52-1.text: 1. A service contract is concluded on the basis of a state body’s act appointing the person to a civil service position.
moscow3-u71c1eba1c157065b52-1.locator: Article 22. Conclusion and entry into force of a service contract

moscow3-u5a25bb78483d3f8dcb-1.text: 2. Upon conclusion of a service contract, the employer’s representative must familiarize the civil servant, against a signed acknowledgement, with the state body’s service rules and the civil service legislation applicable to the performance of the civil servant’s official duties.
moscow3-u5a25bb78483d3f8dcb-1.locator: Article 22. Conclusion and entry into force of a service contract

moscow3-u49a33efa2d63c36311-1.text: 3. A service contract enters into force on the date it is signed by the parties, unless otherwise provided by civil service legislation or the service contract.
moscow3-u49a33efa2d63c36311-1.locator: Article 22. Conclusion and entry into force of a service contract

moscow3-ue678ee071a30f453d4-1.text: 4. A civil servant must begin performing official duties on the date specified in the service contract.
moscow3-ue678ee071a30f453d4-1.locator: Article 22. Conclusion and entry into force of a service contract

moscow3-u84fc8b80c4fae3b738-1.text: 5. If a civil servant fails, without valid reasons, to begin performing official duties within one week of the prescribed date, the service contract is deemed not to have been concluded and the state body’s act of appointment is deemed ineffective.
moscow3-u84fc8b80c4fae3b738-1.locator: Article 22. Conclusion and entry into force of a service contract

moscow3-ufd5567fbbcc49e530d-1.text: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract
moscow3-ufd5567fbbcc49e530d-1.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract

moscow3-u4fa8ab2b77f80ab66d-1.text: 1. A citizen entering the civil service shall present the following to the employer’s representative:
moscow3-u4fa8ab2b77f80ab66d-1.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract

moscow3-u449d4f2d00523f9f50-1.text: 1) an application requesting admission to the civil service and appointment to a civil service position;
moscow3-u449d4f2d00523f9f50-1.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract

moscow3-ueb60ec0222d4b02fc2-1.text: 2) the questionnaire provided for by Article 20.3 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’;
moscow3-ueb60ec0222d4b02fc2-1.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract

moscow3-u3780de830115a1a6b1-1.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract

moscow3-u037b7f60692703a8bc-1.text: 4) an employment record book and/or employment activity information prepared in accordance with the procedure established by labour legislation, except where professional service (employment) activity is undertaken for the first time; 5) a document confirming registration in the individual (personalized) record-keeping system, except where service (employment) activity is undertaken for the first time;
moscow3-u037b7f60692703a8bc-1.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract

moscow3-u10e6acde30542ee845-1.text: 6) a certificate of registration of the individual with the tax authority at their place of residence in the Russian Federation;
moscow3-u10e6acde30542ee845-1.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract

moscow3-u2adbf667dd6676d29e-1.text: 7) military registration documents, for citizens in the reserve and persons liable to conscription;
moscow3-u2adbf667dd6676d29e-1.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract

moscow3-ue8ba6da85f8e4510cd-1.text: 8) a document on education and qualifications;
moscow3-ue8ba6da85f8e4510cd-1.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract

moscow3-u9a9a72d2a9619fa0f1-1.text: 9) information on income, property and property-related obligations.
moscow3-u9a9a72d2a9619fa0f1-1.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract

moscow3-u57432ac6af6504971d-1.text: 10) the information provided for by Article 16.2 of this Law;
moscow3-u57432ac6af6504971d-1.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract

moscow3-u3135236f293c99349e-1.text: 11) a medical organization's opinion confirming the absence of an illness preventing entry into or performance of the civil service.
moscow3-u3135236f293c99349e-1.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract

moscow3-u09b20eab87ccf76fd8-1.text: 2. In individual cases, taking account of the conditions of civil service established by federal civil service legislation, a requirement to present other documents may be provided for upon conclusion of a service contract.
moscow3-u09b20eab87ccf76fd8-1.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract

moscow3-u969a9f0b9ddad59313-1.text: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
moscow3-u969a9f0b9ddad59313-1.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service

moscow3-ud3269baa374e7ee418-1.text: 1. When a service contract is concluded with a citizen entering the civil service for the first time, that contract and the state body's appointment act provide for a probationary period of one month to one year to assess the civil servant's suitability for the position held, unless otherwise provided by this Article.
moscow3-ud3269baa374e7ee418-1.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service

moscow3-u9986e723998e07079e-1.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service

moscow3-u21625d6f27a90b5b3f-1.text: 1) upon appointment to a civil service position of a citizen who has previously performed state service of the Russian Federation — for one to six months; 2) upon appointment of a civil servant to a civil service position by transfer from another state body — for one to six months.
moscow3-u21625d6f27a90b5b3f-1.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service

moscow3-u723db2c6841178d671-1.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service

moscow3-u216a37fb7b57beabba-1.text: 1) citizens who obtained secondary vocational education through a programme for training middle-level specialists or higher education under a targeted education agreement undertaking subsequent civil service, and who enter the civil service for the first time;
moscow3-u216a37fb7b57beabba-1.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service

moscow3-u3fb79def62e3ffdfca-1.text: 2) civil servants appointed to civil service positions by transfer in connection with the liquidation or reorganization of a state body, the reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body;
moscow3-u3fb79def62e3ffdfca-1.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service

moscow3-ud1c25a9e847ad21cba-1.text: 3) other citizens and civil servants for whom the legislation of the Russian Federation provides guarantees of retention of their job (position).
moscow3-ud1c25a9e847ad21cba-1.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service

moscow3-u3fc93d9cb9ae647fa2-1.text: 4. During probation, the provisions of federal laws, this Law and other regulatory legal acts on the civil service apply to the civil servant.
moscow3-u3fc93d9cb9ae647fa2-1.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service

moscow3-u4ad4fe05e9b53d2ad1-1.text: 5. Upon expiry of the prescribed probationary period, if the civil servant does not hold the class rank corresponding to the civil service position held, a class rank is conferred in accordance with Article 8 of this Law.
moscow3-u4ad4fe05e9b53d2ad1-1.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service

moscow3-ub55c22d0f7dacb48cb-1.text: 6. Periods of a civil servant's temporary incapacity for work and other periods when they did not actually perform official duties are excluded from the probationary period.
moscow3-ub55c22d0f7dacb48cb-1.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service

moscow3-u9b1707d7677d258416-1.text: 7. If probation is unsuccessful, the employer's representative may terminate the service contract before the probationary period expires, giving the civil servant written notice at least three days in advance and stating the reasons for finding that the civil servant failed probation.
moscow3-u9b1707d7677d258416-1.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service

moscow3-u8cd12d4b87bc5be46f-1.text: 8. A civil servant may challenge the employer’s representative’s decision in court.
moscow3-u8cd12d4b87bc5be46f-1.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service

moscow3-u9ca6514f4fdf114ec0-1.text: 9. If the probationary period expires and the civil servant continues to hold the civil service position, they are deemed to have passed probation.
moscow3-u9ca6514f4fdf114ec0-1.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service

moscow3-ufcc9b524f78ab137db-1.text: 10. Before the expiry of probation, the service contract may be terminated on the civil servant’s initiative; the civil servant must give the employer’s representative written notice at least three days in advance.
moscow3-ufcc9b524f78ab137db-1.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service

moscow3-ua3dbbe7cd992d45539-1.text: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
moscow3-ua3dbbe7cd992d45539-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-ue77ba86df9dbf5d071-1.text: 1. In the cases established by the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’ and this Law, a civil servant’s transfer to another civil service position in the same state body, including in another locality, or to another civil service position in another state body is permitted: 1) on the employer’s representative’s initiative with the civil servant’s written consent, unless otherwise provided by this Law;
moscow3-ue77ba86df9dbf5d071-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u79e336db66b997b06e-1.text: 2) on the civil servant's initiative, by decision of the employer's representative.
moscow3-u79e336db66b997b06e-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u116ae1a8ffd33512ab-1.text: 2. Unless otherwise provided by the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’ and this Law, a civil servant’s transfer to another civil service position in another state body on the civil servant’s initiative is carried out by agreement between the employer’s representative of the state body in which the civil servant holds a position and the employer’s representative of the receiving state body, and on the basis of the civil servant’s written application submitted at least two weeks before the transfer to the employer’s representative of the state body in which the civil servant holds a position.
moscow3-u116ae1a8ffd33512ab-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u06f60dd22046919e82-1.text: 3. By agreement between the employer's representative of the state body with which the service contract has been concluded and the employer's representative of the state body with which a contract is planned, and with the civil servant's consent, the civil servant may be released from the current position and transferred to another position in the other state body before the date specified in the civil servant's written application.
moscow3-u06f60dd22046919e82-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u1ff729f96b2f2ac21b-1.text: 4. When a service contract is terminated because of transfer to another civil service position in another state body, the civil servant's personnel file is transferred in the prescribed manner to the receiving state body.
moscow3-u1ff729f96b2f2ac21b-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u0a41e2282a49a56ac4-1.text: 5. Transfer to another civil service position in the same state body takes place:
moscow3-u0a41e2282a49a56ac4-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u09d393248b4cac53e9-1.text: 1) on the basis of a competition;
moscow3-u09d393248b4cac53e9-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-ubfe97c30dff549d15c-1.text: 2) upon appointment without a competition in the cases provided for by points 1, 3 and 5 of part 2 and parts 3 and 4 of Article 18 of this Law;
moscow3-ubfe97c30dff549d15c-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-ud6c2ef5c28c56f1db0-1.text: 3) because the civil servant is unable, for health reasons confirmed by a medical opinion, to perform the duties of the position held;
moscow3-ud6c2ef5c28c56f1db0-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u084ab4047e3d9710f6-1.text: 4) because a civil servant who previously held the position is reinstated by court decision;
moscow3-u084ab4047e3d9710f6-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-ub1e512d8ff57800311-1.text: 5) by decision of the employer’s representative, because the civil servant’s clearance for access to state secrets necessary for performing official duties has been terminated, or the civil servant has been refused such clearance, on the ground specified in paragraph four of part one of Article 22 of the Law of the Russian Federation ‘On State Secrets’, relating to the permanent residence abroad of their close relatives specified in Article 21 of the Law of the Russian Federation of 21 July 1993 No. 5485-I ‘On State Secrets’ and/or those persons’ possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state, a residence permit or another document confirming a citizen’s right of permanent residence in a foreign state;
moscow3-ub1e512d8ff57800311-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u63a1197229d4c9a9cd-1.text: 6) upon reduction of the civil service position held by the civil servant in accordance with Article 28 of this Law;
moscow3-u63a1197229d4c9a9cd-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u46428c4fcbacb58a11-1.text: 7) in connection with the civil servant’s rotation in accordance with Article 60.1 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’; 8) in connection with demotion in civil service position and removal from the personnel reserve, if included in it, following appraisal in accordance with point 3 of part 16 of Article 37 of this Law;
moscow3-u46428c4fcbacb58a11-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-uc5d5be695099fd905b-1.text: 9) because it is necessary to eliminate circumstances involving direct subordination or accountability between civil servants who are close relatives or related by affinity, in order to ensure compliance with the restriction provided for by point 5 of part 1 of Article 12 of this Law;
moscow3-uc5d5be695099fd905b-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u5b50f529deb5ea391f-1.text: 10) because the civil servant needs to fill another civil service position temporarily in accordance with Article 27 of this Law;
moscow3-u5b50f529deb5ea391f-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u112ea09e4e3831981b-1.text: 11) upon refusal of a civil service position offered through rotation in the cases provided for by parts 9 and 9.1 of Article 60.1 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’;
moscow3-u112ea09e4e3831981b-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u44722c5bd9663baae5-1.text: 12) where the civil servant does not agree to continue holding a civil service position because of changes in the conditions of professional service activities entailing amendment of the service contract terms in accordance with Article 26 of this Law;
moscow3-u44722c5bd9663baae5-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-ubfcf1dfd89d5de9570-1.text: 13) in connection with expiry of the established term of office of a civil servant holding a position in the ‘managers’ or ‘assistants (advisers)’ category, in the case provided for by part 4 of Article 35 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’;
moscow3-ubfcf1dfd89d5de9570-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u446b7e1bcabfbe87ea-1.text: 14) where a civil servant holds citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state which has not been terminated for reasons beyond their control, in exceptional cases, in accordance with the procedure and subject to the conditions established by point 14 of part 5 of Article 28 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
moscow3-u446b7e1bcabfbe87ea-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u1b14970cb374fbc64e-1.text: 6. A civil servant’s transfer to another civil service position in another state body takes place: 1) on the basis of a competition;
moscow3-u1b14970cb374fbc64e-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-ubfe97c30dff549d15c-2.text: 2) upon appointment without a competition in the cases provided for by points 1, 3 and 5 of part 2 and parts 3 and 4 of Article 18 of this Law;
moscow3-ubfe97c30dff549d15c-2.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-ucbf6677890364dc2a2-1.text: 3) upon reduction of a civil service position or abolition of a state body in accordance with Article 28 of this Law;
moscow3-ucbf6677890364dc2a2-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-uefa1270b1f7fb90b1b-1.text: 4) in connection with the civil servant’s rotation in accordance with Article 60.1 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’;
moscow3-uefa1270b1f7fb90b1b-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u285ce561bdacc6155b-1.text: 5) upon refusal of a civil service position offered through rotation in the cases provided for by parts 9 and 9.1 of Article 60.1 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
moscow3-u285ce561bdacc6155b-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u6d33b92d7cd19aa9af-1.text: 7. Transfer to another civil service position in the cases provided for by this Article requires the civil servant to meet the qualification requirements for that other position.
moscow3-u6d33b92d7cd19aa9af-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u96e475ce1339e70f48-1.text: 8. In the cases provided for by points 3-5, 9 and 12-14 of part 5 of this Article, transfer of a civil servant to another civil service position involving demotion is permitted only where it is impossible to transfer the civil servant to a position in the same category and group as the position currently held and with a position salary no lower than that of the position currently held.
moscow3-u96e475ce1339e70f48-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u2747dc31dd8e1c1ded-1.text: 9. Transfer to another civil service position in the same state body under this Article is formalized by a legal act of the state body and accompanied by amendment of the service contract through a supplementary agreement.
moscow3-u2747dc31dd8e1c1ded-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u2476dc73cef9975ac2-1.text: 10. Unless otherwise provided by federal laws, where transfer under points 3-5, 8, 9 and 12-14 of part 5 of this Article is impossible because no other civil service position is available, or where the civil servant refuses a transfer under this Article, the civil servant shall be dismissed from the civil service. In these cases, the service contract is terminated, the civil servant is released from the position held and dismissed from the civil service in accordance with point 8 of part 1 of Article 33 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, unless another ground for dismissal is expressly established by that Federal Law; by decision of the employer’s representative and with the civil servant’s consent, the civil servant is included in the personnel reserve, except in the case provided for by point 8 of part 5 of this Article.
moscow3-u2476dc73cef9975ac2-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-u36474f98c502d21260-1.text: 11. Reassignment to another structural subdivision of the same state body in the same locality is not a transfer to another civil service position and does not require the civil servant's consent if it does not change the terms of the service contract, except the term concerning the place of civil service.
moscow3-u36474f98c502d21260-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-uadde5befe814bbb276-1.text: 12. Before the service contract is terminated in connection with transfer to another state body, the civil servant may withdraw their application or consent at any time.
moscow3-uadde5befe814bbb276-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-ue52b2c24cc08c283e9-1.text: 13. A civil servant who is subject to an internal service inquiry or an investigation into compliance with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and the fulfilment of duties established for the purpose of combating corruption by the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’, other federal laws and this Law may not be transferred to another civil service position in the same state body (except a transfer, in the cases specified in points 3-6, 9, 10, 13 and 14 of part 5 of this Article, to a position whose position salary does not exceed that of the position currently held) or to another state body.
moscow3-ue52b2c24cc08c283e9-1.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment

moscow3-ua4d2859c8a68073099-1.text: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities
moscow3-ua4d2859c8a68073099-1.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities

moscow3-udf22d8d4187debd87d-1.text: 1. If changes in a civil servant's professional service conditions make it impossible to retain the service contract terms, those terms may be changed on the employer's representative's initiative, with the civil servant's written consent, without changing the civil servant's official duties.
moscow3-udf22d8d4187debd87d-1.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities

moscow3-u3b85d72b2eb1988b0d-1.text: 2. Reasons for changes in professional service conditions entailing changes to service contract terms without changes to official duties include:
moscow3-u3b85d72b2eb1988b0d-1.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities

moscow3-u1a043406ba862c67a8-1.text: 1) inclusion of the position held in the list of civil service positions subject to rotation, or removal of the position from that list;
moscow3-u1a043406ba862c67a8-1.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities

moscow3-u8545972c9660c2bdf8-1.text: 2) relocation to another locality of the state body or its structural subdivision in which the civil servant holds a position;
moscow3-u8545972c9660c2bdf8-1.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities

moscow3-ud8cf2efa1227871113-1.text: 3) changes to remuneration terms in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation;
moscow3-ud8cf2efa1227871113-1.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities

moscow3-u0abaef0aabdf68ecad-1.text: 4) changes to the legislation of the Russian Federation;
moscow3-u0abaef0aabdf68ecad-1.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities

moscow3-u3428e267dbebe2f3d9-1.text: 5) amendment of the service contract terms provided for by point 6 of part 2 of Article 20 of this Law.
moscow3-u3428e267dbebe2f3d9-1.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities

moscow3-u4aad5b636a5ffc4f05-1.text: 3. The employer's representative must notify the civil servant in writing of forthcoming changes to the service contract terms and the reasons for them at least two months before they take effect, except for the changes provided for by points 3 and 4 of part 2 of this Article.
moscow3-u4aad5b636a5ffc4f05-1.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities

moscow3-u4936392cd5c412347e-1.text: 4. If a civil servant does not agree to continue state service relations in the current position because changes in professional service conditions entail changes to the service contract, other than the changes in points 3 and 4 of part 2 of this Article, and the state body has other vacant civil service positions retaining those professional service conditions, the employer's representative must offer those vacancies in writing against acknowledgement of receipt, taking account of the category and group of the current position, provided that the civil servant meets the qualification requirements for the position.
moscow3-u4936392cd5c412347e-1.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities

moscow3-u437a1852ebfd34c6e8-1.text: 5. If a civil servant refuses in writing to continue state service relations in the civil service position held because of changes in professional service conditions entailing amendment of the service contract terms as provided for by points 3 and 4 of part 2 of this Article, the service contract is terminated in accordance with point 7 of part 1 of Article 33 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
moscow3-u437a1852ebfd34c6e8-1.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities

moscow3-u1fce1cedacafb04e88-1.text: 6. If a civil servant refuses in writing another civil service position offered because of changes in professional service conditions entailing amendment of the service contract terms, or if no such position is available in the same state body, the service contract is terminated in accordance with point 7 of part 1 of Article 33 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
moscow3-u1fce1cedacafb04e88-1.locator: Article 26. Amendment of the terms of a service contract in connection with a change in the conditions of professional service activities

moscow3-ud998c704e14d0e0ab9-1.text: Article 27. Temporary filling of another civil service position
moscow3-ud998c704e14d0e0ab9-1.locator: Article 27. Temporary filling of another civil service position

moscow3-u8dba85d502db71b3d4-1.text: 1. In the event of service necessity, the employer’s representative may transfer a civil servant for up to one month to a civil service position in the same state body not specified in the service contract, with monetary remuneration for the position temporarily held, but no less than the established average wage for the position previously held. Such transfer is permitted to prevent a catastrophe, industrial accident or natural disaster, to remedy their consequences, to prevent accidents, temporary suspension of professional service activities for economic, technological, technical or organizational reasons, or destruction of or damage to property, and to replace a temporarily absent civil servant. A civil servant may not, however, be transferred to another civil service position contraindicated by their state of health.
moscow3-u8dba85d502db71b3d4-1.locator: Article 27. Temporary filling of another civil service position

moscow3-ub06f8c3eed90b8cb97-1.text: 2. Transfer to replace a temporarily absent civil servant may not exceed one month in a calendar year.
moscow3-ub06f8c3eed90b8cb97-1.locator: Article 27. Temporary filling of another civil service position

moscow3-u83f03f97f77fe07c49-1.text: 3. By agreement of the parties, the employer’s representative may appoint a civil servant to a civil service position not specified in the service contract that was previously held by a temporarily absent civil servant, including a position in a higher group, with the position salary for the position temporarily held, but no less than the position salary for the position previously held, payment of the allowances established for the position temporarily held, and provision of state social guarantees. By agreement of the parties, the civil servant may retain the civil service position previously held.
moscow3-u83f03f97f77fe07c49-1.locator: Article 27. Temporary filling of another civil service position

moscow3-u75f56ac4358982ea3f-1.text: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body
moscow3-u75f56ac4358982ea3f-1.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body

moscow3-u4b21f15688dc64f2d3-1.text: 1. Upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body, state service relations continue if the civil servant holding a position being reduced or a position in the body being abolished is offered, with their written consent, another civil service position in the same state body, in the state body receiving the abolished body's functions, or in another state body, taking account of:
moscow3-u4b21f15688dc64f2d3-1.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body

moscow3-u5440955e1848859802-1.text: 1) their professional level, specialty, field of training, and length of civil service or work experience in the specialty or field of training; 2) their level of professional education and length of civil service or work experience in the specialty or field of training, provided they receive additional professional education corresponding to the field and type of professional service activities of the position offered.
moscow3-u5440955e1848859802-1.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body

moscow3-ueb1b98edb3af69359a-1.text: 2. A civil servant holding a position being reduced or a position in a state body being abolished is personally notified by the employer's representative, against acknowledgement of receipt, of the forthcoming dismissal due to reduction of positions or abolition of the body at least two months before dismissal.
moscow3-ueb1b98edb3af69359a-1.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body

moscow3-ufd4c88bcb18e1cd16d-1.text: 3. During the period specified in part 2 of this Article, an extraordinary appraisal of civil servants may be conducted in the state body in accordance with Article 37 of this Law. On the basis of that appraisal, civil servants with a preferential right to hold a civil service position may be offered other civil service positions, including in another state body.
moscow3-ufd4c88bcb18e1cd16d-1.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body

moscow3-u01f886e514d4c233df-1.text: 4. A preferential right to hold a civil service position is given to a civil servant with a higher professional level, a specialty and field of training corresponding to the field and type of their professional service activity, longer civil service or work experience in the specialty or field of training, and better results of professional service activity.
moscow3-u01f886e514d4c233df-1.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body

moscow3-u5c2591a5a5c726ca77-1.text: 5. Within two months after notifying a civil servant of dismissal, the employer's representative of the state body reducing civil service positions, or of the state body receiving the functions of an abolished body, must offer the civil servant holding a position being reduced or a position in the abolished body all vacant civil service positions available in the same body or the body receiving those functions, respectively, taking account of the category and group of the current position, the civil servant's professional level, specialty, field of training, and length of civil service or work in the specialty or field of training. If no such positions exist in those bodies, the representative may offer vacancies in other state bodies in the manner determined by the Government of the Russian Federation.
moscow3-u5c2591a5a5c726ca77-1.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body

moscow3-u4c88b9f7f11f8bee82-1.text: 6. If, upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body, a civil servant refuses another civil service position offered, including in another state body, the civil servant is released from the position held and dismissed from the civil service. In this case, the service contract is terminated, upon reduction of civil service positions, in accordance with point 8(2) of part 1 of Article 37 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, and, upon abolition of a state body, in accordance with point 8(3) of part 1 of Article 37 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
moscow3-u4c88b9f7f11f8bee82-1.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body

moscow3-ubcf7ee53982f0cf94e-1.text: 7. With the civil servant's written consent, the employer's representative may terminate the service contract before the period specified in part 2 of this Article expires, paying additional compensation equal to retained monetary remuneration calculated proportionately to the time remaining until expiry of the dismissal notice period.
moscow3-ubcf7ee53982f0cf94e-1.locator: Article 28. Relations connected with the civil service in the event of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body

moscow3-u3147745d496464dd83-1.text: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held
moscow3-u3147745d496464dd83-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-uec1ee316647cedf0f0-1.text: 1. The employer’s representative must temporarily suspend from the civil service position held (not permit to perform official duties) a civil servant:
moscow3-uec1ee316647cedf0f0-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-u2e24fee5561ed6c6c8-1.text: 1) who reports for service under the influence of alcohol, narcotic drugs or other toxic substances;
moscow3-u2e24fee5561ed6c6c8-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-u1fd731eb687e2b38b6-1.text: 2) who has not undergone the prescribed training and assessment of knowledge and skills in protection of professional service activity (occupational safety);
moscow3-u1fd731eb687e2b38b6-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-u2ab9dd772f28333756-1.text: 3) at the request of bodies or officials authorized by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
moscow3-u2ab9dd772f28333756-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-u5bf55f511abeca4c71-1.text: 2. This part was repealed with effect from 21 February 2020 by Law of the City of Moscow of 29 January 2020 No. 2.
moscow3-u5bf55f511abeca4c71-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-u5d4302c6a592dc9e24-1.text: 3. The employer's representative may suspend a civil servant from the position held (not permit performance of official duties) for the period of:
moscow3-u5d4302c6a592dc9e24-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-u8aab8c79fd8786dbfa-1.text: 1) resolution of a conflict of interest;
moscow3-u8aab8c79fd8786dbfa-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-u117e93456da52d8545-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-uf2122616f9004602da-1.text: а) the accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure submitted by the civil servant in accordance with the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other federal laws; б) information submitted by the civil servant upon entry into the civil service in accordance with regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation;
moscow3-uf2122616f9004602da-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-uff33a771f94b3b62ee-1.text: в) the civil servant’s compliance with restrictions and prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and fulfilment of duties established by the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’, other federal laws and this Law.
moscow3-uff33a771f94b3b62ee-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-uefe776ec146d6d84ad-1.text: 3) an internal service inquiry in accordance with Article 48 of this Law.
moscow3-uefe776ec146d6d84ad-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-u31b9fa118e25971a8f-1.text: 3.1. In the cases specified in part 3 of this Article, a civil servant may be suspended from the civil service position held (not permitted to perform official duties) for no more than 60 days from the decision to resolve the conflict of interest or conduct the investigation. This period may be extended to 90 days by the person who took the relevant decision. The civil servant retains monetary remuneration for the entire period of suspension from the position held (performance of official duties).
moscow3-u31b9fa118e25971a8f-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-u4d08673b1ab24185ce-1.text: 4. The employer’s representative suspends a civil servant from the civil service position held (does not permit performance of official duties) for the entire period until the circumstances constituting the grounds for suspension from the position held (non-admission to performance of official duties) have been eliminated.
moscow3-u4d08673b1ab24185ce-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-u98fac08f64bb44ed8a-1.text: 5. A civil servant suspended from the civil service position held may not be appointed to another civil service position.
moscow3-u98fac08f64bb44ed8a-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-ubcc93921b991ffbb8d-1.text: 6. During suspension of a civil servant from the civil service position held (non-admission to performance of official duties) on any of the grounds provided for by part 1 of this Article, monetary remuneration is not retained. During suspension of a civil servant from the position held (non-admission to performance of official duties) on any of the grounds provided for by part 3 of this Article, monetary remuneration for the civil service position held is retained for the period of suspension.
moscow3-ubcc93921b991ffbb8d-1.locator: Article 29. Suspension from a civil service position held

moscow3-udd757b69ec6be636f4-1.text: Article 30. Grounds for release from a civil service position held, termination of a service contract and/or dismissal from the civil service
moscow3-udd757b69ec6be636f4-1.locator: Article 30. Grounds for release from a civil service position held, termination of a service contract and/or dismissal from the civil service

moscow3-u0b6d0c6ce0d5d59324-1.text: 2. Release from a civil service position held, termination of a service contract and dismissal from the civil service are formalized by an act of a state body.
moscow3-u0b6d0c6ce0d5d59324-1.locator: Article 30. Grounds for release from a civil service position held, termination of a service contract and/or dismissal from the civil service

moscow3-u830af1833c6d747188-1.text: 3. On the civil servant’s final day of performing official duties, the employer’s representative must make the final settlement with the civil servant and issue their employment record book or provide employment activity information for the period of civil service in the relevant state body. At the civil servant’s written request, the employer’s representative must also issue other documents connected with civil service and pension provision. Employment activity information is provided by the method specified in the civil servant’s application (on paper, duly certified, or as an electronic document signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature, if the employer’s representative has one); the application is submitted by the civil servant in writing or sent, in accordance with the procedure established by the employer’s representative, to the employer’s representative’s email address.
moscow3-u830af1833c6d747188-1.locator: Article 30. Grounds for release from a civil service position held, termination of a service contract and/or dismissal from the civil service

moscow3-u475988da70fb8ec567-1.text: 4. On the day of release from the civil service position held and/or dismissal from the civil service, a civil servant must surrender their service identity card to the state body’s personnel service. Chapter 6. Personal data of a civil servant. Personnel service of a state body
moscow3-u475988da70fb8ec567-1.locator: Article 30. Grounds for release from a civil service position held, termination of a service contract and/or dismissal from the civil service

moscow3-uf3469cc5b0014e7f72-1.text: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file
moscow3-uf3469cc5b0014e7f72-1.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file

moscow3-ud1be0a832e5dca27d6-1.text: 1. When processing a civil servant's personal data, the personnel service of a state body shall comply with the following requirements:
moscow3-ud1be0a832e5dca27d6-1.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file

moscow3-u2c0f4ddacee10a3175-1.text: 1) a civil servant’s personal data are processed in compliance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data, other federal laws and other regulatory legal acts, for the purposes of assisting the civil servant in civil service, education and career advancement, ensuring the personal safety of the civil servant and their family members and the security of their property, recording the results of the performance of official duties, and ensuring the security of the state body’s property;
moscow3-u2c0f4ddacee10a3175-1.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file

moscow3-u2793cdad772cf2ab6d-1.text: 2) personal data are submitted by the civil servant personally. Where necessary, personal data may be obtained from a third party with the civil servant’s written consent;
moscow3-u2793cdad772cf2ab6d-1.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file

moscow3-u97d2b5e9557f56e43d-1.text: 3) personal data on a civil servant’s political, religious and other beliefs, private life, or membership of public associations, including trade unions, which are not provided for by federal laws may not be processed or included in the civil servant’s personnel file;
moscow3-u97d2b5e9557f56e43d-1.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file

moscow3-u5f7ced85e8b2de3cf7-1.text: 4) decisions producing legal consequences for a civil servant or otherwise affecting their rights and legitimate interests may not be based on the civil servant's personal data obtained solely as a result of automated processing, except in cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data;
moscow3-u5f7ced85e8b2de3cf7-1.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file

moscow3-u69fe07a9ac3793c631-1.text: 5) protection of a civil servant’s personal data against unlawful use or loss is funded by the state body in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws;
moscow3-u69fe07a9ac3793c631-1.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file

moscow3-ub4c4eb10037424c176-1.text: 6) a civil servant’s personal data may not be transferred to a third party without the civil servant’s written consent, except in cases established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data. The conditions and procedure for transferring a civil servant’s personal data to a third party are established by federal regulatory legal acts.
moscow3-ub4c4eb10037424c176-1.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file

moscow3-u669c2565386a80f254-1.text: 2. A civil servant responsible for violating rules governing the processing of another civil servant’s personal data bears liability in accordance with federal laws.
moscow3-u669c2565386a80f254-1.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file

moscow3-uca5a2a2b7972ed2b9d-1.text: 3. A civil servant’s personal data and other information connected with entry into, performance of and dismissal from the civil service are entered in their personnel file.
moscow3-uca5a2a2b7972ed2b9d-1.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file

moscow3-uf65361bd4992281d5a-1.text: 4. The regulation on the personal data of a state civil servant and maintenance of a state civil servant’s personnel file is established by federal regulatory legal acts.
moscow3-uf65361bd4992281d5a-1.locator: Article 31. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant’s personnel file

moscow3-u9e80b9dc6099ccd22b-1.text: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants
moscow3-u9e80b9dc6099ccd22b-1.locator: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants

moscow3-u5b6adf1b15327e4a47-1.text: 1. The employer’s representative maintains the register of state civil servants of the state body.
moscow3-u5b6adf1b15327e4a47-1.locator: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants

moscow3-u2295e111620c40ff6f-1.text: 2. Information from a civil servant’s personnel file is included in the register of state civil servants of the state body and stored in the databases of the City of Moscow’s state information system in the field of civil service, with protection against unauthorized access and copying.
moscow3-u2295e111620c40ff6f-1.locator: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants

moscow3-ue97181f46bbf1dffbe-1.text: 3. A civil servant who has died (been killed), or who has been declared missing or dead by a court decision that has entered into legal force, is removed from the state body’s register of state civil servants on the day following the date of death or the entry into legal force of the court decision.
moscow3-ue97181f46bbf1dffbe-1.locator: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants

moscow3-uf0fa2006f015017c76-2.text: 4. This part was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24.
moscow3-uf0fa2006f015017c76-2.locator: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants

moscow3-uba64f94323d5381bf8-2.text: 5. This part was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24.
moscow3-uba64f94323d5381bf8-2.locator: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants

moscow3-u226387909cef64ea0a-1.text: 6. This part was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24.
moscow3-u226387909cef64ea0a-1.locator: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants

moscow3-u0503b939190f6d5d13-1.text: 1) forming the personnel complement to fill civil service positions, including recruiting and attracting personnel, assessing the professional level of applicants for civil service positions and checking compliance with the qualification requirements for such positions;

moscow3-u650673d7bdac1890bd-1.text: 2) preparing proposals for implementing the provisions of federal laws, this Law and other regulatory legal acts on the civil service, and submitting those proposals to the employer’s representative;

moscow3-u064c2fd47e1db5c7d9-1.text: 3) organizing the drafting of acts of the state body and formalizing its decisions connected with entry into, performance of and termination of the civil service, including conclusion of service contracts, appointment to civil service positions, nomination for civil service incentives and awards, imposition of disciplinary sanctions, release from civil service positions held, dismissal from the civil service and retirement on a length-of-service pension; 4) maintaining civil servants’ employment record books (where available), compiling employment activity information for their period of civil service, and submitting that information, in accordance with the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on individual (personalized) record-keeping in the compulsory pension insurance system, for storage in the information resources of the Pension and Social Insurance Fund of the Russian Federation;

moscow3-u513beb36c0793d2027-1.text: 6) maintaining the state body’s register of state civil servants;

moscow3-ub6242092031edd728a-1.text: 7) preparing and issuing civil servants' official identity cards;

moscow3-udaf80958322b3f1970-1.text: 8) supporting the work of the conflict-of-interest resolution commission;

moscow3-ud9ea3b1e93f7c3afb9-1.text: 9) organizing and supporting competitions to fill civil service positions and to include civil servants and citizens in the personnel reserve;

moscow3-u2b8ce39923279bc17b-1.text: 10) organizing and supporting the appraisal of civil servants (hereinafter also referred to as appraisal);

moscow3-u12d7a9c52c9e1f42ba-1.text: 11) this point was repealed with effect from 29 April 2023 by Law of the City of Moscow of 19 April 2023 No. 10,;

moscow3-u54928d99aab18dc758-1.text: 12) organizing the conclusion of targeted education agreements;

moscow3-u328733c105ff442cd8-1.text: 14) forming the personnel reserve, organizing work with it and ensuring its effective use;

moscow3-u3a9b15b80d795e04e9-1.text: 16) organizing and conducting checks of information submitted by a citizen upon entry into the civil service and during their service as a civil servant; 16.1) arranging clearance in the prescribed form for access to state secrets;

moscow3-ub7e189924ffe45a73d-1.text: 18) organizing verification of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and of civil servants’ compliance with restrictions established by federal laws;

moscow3-u0722764274064165df-1.text: 19) advising civil servants on legal and other civil service matters;

moscow3-u73794f94b4d060db00-1.text: 20) providing the state service management body with information on all areas of personnel work in accordance with the procedure established by regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow;

moscow3-u6681e5d5c392357e8b-1.text: 21) performing other tasks in accordance with the Model Regulation on a State Body’s Structural Subdivision for State Service and Personnel Matters.

moscow3-u5bd39c52afac32a293-1.text: 1.1. Personnel work uses the City of Moscow’s state information system in the field of civil service, which must be compatible with the federal state information system in the field of state service and comply with the uniform requirements for the volume and content of information on the staffing of state bodies that is to be stored, processed and transmitted electronically.

moscow3-u1c2c8ef9585c86ce2c-1.text: 2. Personnel work in a state body is carried out by a structural subdivision for state service and personnel matters whose activities are directly supervised and coordinated by the employer’s representative, or by a specially authorized civil servant directly subordinate to the employer’s representative.

moscow3-u9d163459f982ac2bb5-1.text: 3. Appointment to and release from civil service positions of heads of structural subdivisions for state service and personnel matters and of specially authorized civil servants, and the imposition of disciplinary sanctions on them, are carried out in accordance with the established procedure in agreement with the state service management body.

moscow3-ua8eacd91ed1b8963f5-1.text: 4. The Model Regulation on a State Body’s Structural Subdivision for State Service and Personnel Matters is approved by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow.

moscow3-ua89982e74fd559790a-1.text: 5. The regulation on a state body’s structural subdivision for state service and personnel matters is approved by the head of the state body.

moscow3-u0585faa5431a9fe9ff-1.text: 6. A structural subdivision for state service and personnel matters may not be assigned additional functions not provided for by this Law and the relevant decree of the Mayor of Moscow.

moscow3-ucf5ffad8734b680383-1.text: Chapter 7. Service time and rest time. Leave in the civil service
moscow3-ucf5ffad8734b680383-1.locator: Chapter 7. Service time and rest time. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u62fe8c4f0f755e18ad-1.text: Article 34. Service time and rest time
moscow3-u62fe8c4f0f755e18ad-1.locator: Article 34. Service time and rest time

moscow3-u28ed64d28c19d89123-1.text: 1. Service time is the time during which a civil servant must perform official duties in accordance with the state body’s service rules, the service schedule or the terms of the service contract, and other periods classified as service time by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts.
moscow3-u28ed64d28c19d89123-1.locator: Article 34. Service time and rest time

moscow3-u8049d2060cd7568b26-1.text: 2. The normal duration of service time for a civil servant may not exceed 40 hours per week. A five-day service week shall be established for civil servants.
moscow3-u8049d2060cd7568b26-1.locator: Article 34. Service time and rest time

moscow3-ufc2468a293597e89be-1.text: 3. An irregular service day is established for civil servants holding the highest and principal civil service positions.
moscow3-ufc2468a293597e89be-1.locator: Article 34. Service time and rest time

moscow3-u4ce4758ac6c201cb46-1.text: 4. For civil servants holding positions in other groups, an irregular service day is established in accordance with the list of civil service positions subject to an irregular service day established by the state body’s service rules or the service contract.
moscow3-u4ce4758ac6c201cb46-1.locator: Article 34. Service time and rest time

moscow3-u785619d9017a246db9-1.text: 5. The right to rest is realized by providing a civil servant with time free from the performance of official duties (free time) outside the normal duration of service time established by federal laws.
moscow3-u785619d9017a246db9-1.locator: Article 34. Service time and rest time

moscow3-uc6b8192be28d5f913e-1.text: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
moscow3-uc6b8192be28d5f913e-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-ue8a28734a9b09073c4-1.text: 1. A civil servant shall be granted annual leave with retention of the civil service position held and monetary remuneration.
moscow3-ue8a28734a9b09073c4-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u35411561ee904f7448-1.text: 2. A civil servant's annual paid leave shall consist of basic paid leave and additional paid leave.
