moscow3-u35411561ee904f7448-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-ub9b97ca865f6aed11f-1.text: 3. Civil servants shall be granted basic annual paid leave of 30 calendar days.
moscow3-ub9b97ca865f6aed11f-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-ucbc2a125cb047e312a-1.text: 4. Civil servants shall be granted additional annual paid leave for length of service of the following duration:
moscow3-ucbc2a125cb047e312a-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u3f04857643be5ee5bf-1.text: 1) for civil service length from 1 year to 5 years — 1 calendar day;
moscow3-u3f04857643be5ee5bf-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u827082aceb3492c58f-1.text: 2) for civil service length from 5 to 10 years — 5 calendar days;
moscow3-u827082aceb3492c58f-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u8750b3448b744c74ff-1.text: 3) for civil service length from 10 to 15 years — 7 calendar days;
moscow3-u8750b3448b744c74ff-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u909569ddea73ba3211-1.text: 4) for civil service length of 15 years or more — 10 calendar days.
moscow3-u909569ddea73ba3211-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u51269a7b76fbf19110-1.text: 5. This part was repealed with effect from 21 October 2016 by Law of the City of Moscow of 28 September 2016 No. 32
moscow3-u51269a7b76fbf19110-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u99522cb6c261af3cc6-1.text: 6. Civil servants subject to an irregular service day shall be granted additional annual paid leave for irregular service days of three calendar days.
moscow3-u99522cb6c261af3cc6-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-uf0cb3e03ba674054de-1.text: 7. This part was repealed with effect from 21 October 2016 by Law of the City of Moscow of 28 September 2016 No. 32
moscow3-uf0cb3e03ba674054de-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u5841c94e423ae7e065-1.text: 8. Additional leave for civil servants subject to an irregular service day, and in other cases provided for by federal laws, is granted in addition to the combined basic annual paid leave and additional annual paid leave for length of service.
moscow3-u5841c94e423ae7e065-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u9708fd6453e85ec03f-1.text: 9. This part was repealed with effect from 16 April 2016 by Law of the City of Moscow of 23 March 2016 No. 11.
moscow3-u9708fd6453e85ec03f-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u76325cc66898104451-1.text: 10. A civil servant must be granted annual paid leave each year in accordance with a leave schedule approved by the employer’s representative no later than two weeks before the start of the calendar year.
moscow3-u76325cc66898104451-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u08c9a73cd741ae7690-1.text: 10.1. The minimum duration of annual paid leave taken by a civil servant in the service year for which it is granted may not be less than 28 calendar days. At least one portion of the annual paid leave must be at least 14 calendar days.
moscow3-u08c9a73cd741ae7690-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-uac1262cba32317d514-1.text: 10.2. In exceptional cases, where granting a civil servant annual paid leave in the current service year for the total duration calculated in accordance with parts 3 and 4 of this Article may adversely affect the performance of the state body’s tasks and functions or the exercise of powers by a person holding a state office of the City of Moscow, the portion of annual paid leave exceeding 28 calendar days may, by decision of the employer’s representative and with the civil servant’s written consent, be carried over to the next service year. The portion carried over must be used no later than 12 months after the end of the service year for which it was granted.
moscow3-uac1262cba32317d514-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u9b1fb66d8dd50f3ce8-1.text: 10.3. The portion of annual paid leave exceeding 28 calendar days, or any number of days from that portion, may be replaced by monetary compensation upon the civil servant's written application.
moscow3-u9b1fb66d8dd50f3ce8-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u7914d103a1cb2ce562-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u7f9b44e2e9db46e2b1-1.text: 11. A civil servant's monetary remuneration for the period of annual paid leave must be paid no later than 10 calendar days before the leave begins.
moscow3-u7f9b44e2e9db46e2b1-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u3962180f7bae88829f-1.text: 12. When a civil servant is granted annual paid leave, regardless of its duration, a lump-sum payment equal to two monthly remuneration salaries is made once a year.
moscow3-u3962180f7bae88829f-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u0cc80d854a0b2e9391-1.text: 13. It is prohibited to deny civil servants annual paid leave for two consecutive years.
moscow3-u0cc80d854a0b2e9391-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u4c49b0a67d4a261123-1.text: 14. Upon termination or cancellation of a service contract, release from the civil service position held and dismissal from civil service, the civil servant shall be paid monetary compensation for all unused leave. Upon the civil servant's written application, unused leave may be granted followed by dismissal (except where release from the civil service position and dismissal from civil service are due to culpable acts). In that case, the last day of leave shall be considered the date of release from the civil service position and dismissal from civil service.
moscow3-u4c49b0a67d4a261123-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-ua27c7a9147feee6906-1.text: 15. In the event of dismissal due to expiry of the service contract, leave followed by dismissal may also be granted where the leave falls wholly or partly beyond the term of the service contract. In that case, the last day of leave shall likewise be considered the date of release from the civil service position and dismissal from civil service.
moscow3-ua27c7a9147feee6906-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u93e8eec35a954d4687-1.text: 16. For family circumstances or other valid reasons, a civil servant may, upon their written application and by decision of the employer's representative, be granted leave without monetary remuneration for no more than one year. A civil servant shall also be granted leave without monetary remuneration in other cases provided for by federal laws.
moscow3-u93e8eec35a954d4687-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u49cb56cc4ef23b9713-1.text: 17. During leave without monetary remuneration, the civil servant shall retain the civil service position held.
moscow3-u49cb56cc4ef23b9713-1.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service

moscow3-u1f6ec4e8769edd745a-1.text: 1. A civil servant's professional service activities shall be carried out in accordance with official duties regulations approved by the employer's representative.

moscow3-u01cd04da583d91b160-1.text: 2. The official duties regulations shall include:

moscow3-u12402fb9dd0331e527-1.text: 1) qualification requirements for holding the civil service position;

moscow3-uc864c4311c9a9e3e90-1.text: 2) official duties; 3) the list of matters on which the civil servant may or must independently take managerial and other decisions;

moscow3-ua36a7562c449d0f76c-1.text: 4) the list of matters on which the civil servant may or must participate in drafting regulatory legal acts and/or managerial and other decisions;

moscow3-uda312144c0cee6b07c-1.text: 5) time limits and procedures for preparing and considering draft managerial and other decisions, and the procedure for coordinating and adopting those decisions;

moscow3-ufef57cf3f21fb90b57-1.text: 6) the procedure for a civil servant’s official interaction, in connection with the performance of official duties, with civil servants of the same state body, civil servants of other state bodies, other citizens and organizations;

moscow3-u0ac93cc7fb5e72670c-1.text: 7) the list of state services provided by the civil servant to citizens and organizations in accordance with the state body’s administrative regulations;

moscow3-u7b10db9000925040fa-1.text: 8) indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of the civil servant’s professional service activities, determined on the basis of general and specific indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of state bodies’ activities, the adoption and implementation of managerial and other decisions, and the legal, organizational and documentary support for implementation of those decisions. Specific indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of state bodies’ activities, the adoption and implementation of managerial and other decisions, and the legal, organizational and documentary support for implementation of those decisions are approved by an act of the state body in accordance with the particular nature of its tasks and functions. They are determined on the basis of the general indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of state bodies’ activities, the adoption and implementation of managerial and other decisions, and the legal, organizational and documentary support for implementation of those decisions, which are common to state bodies and civil servants and approved, respectively, by the President of the Russian Federation and the Government of the Russian Federation.

moscow3-uc6671070d17ee1d82f-1.text: 3. The provisions of the official duties regulations shall be taken into account when conducting a competition to fill a vacant civil service position or for inclusion in the state body's personnel reserve, when making an appointment to a civil service position without a competition, during attestation, and when planning the civil servant's professional service activities and professional development.

moscow3-u79315e75dacba8e0e2-1.text: 4. A civil servant's compliance with the official duties regulations shall be taken into account when they participate in a competition to fill a vacant civil service position or are included in the state body's personnel reserve, when they are appointed to a civil service position without a competition, and when their professional service activities are assessed during attestation or when an incentive is granted.

moscow3-u990315499e42b24cc0-1.text: 5. Model official duties regulations are approved by the state service management body.

moscow3-ufd620bc7381bd99bb8-1.text: 1. A civil servant is appraised to determine their suitability for the civil service position held; the appraisal includes an assessment of their professional service activities and their professional level.

moscow3-u5fa1528804a937d78c-1.text: 2. During an appraisal, the civil servant’s immediate supervisor submits a reasoned review of the civil servant’s performance of official duties over the appraisal period. The reasoned review is accompanied by information, contained in the civil servant’s annual reports on professional service activities, about instructions carried out and draft documents prepared during the appraisal period and, where necessary, the civil servant’s explanatory note responding to the immediate supervisor’s review.

moscow3-u566d3ebf6f2ff8f2a7-1.text: 3. Civil servants holding positions in the ‘managers’ category under fixed-term service contracts, and civil servants holding positions in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category, are not subject to appraisal.

moscow3-uc8504534c5c6fbe897-1.text: 4. A civil servant is appraised once every three years.

moscow3-u30742e69521a52a3b3-1.text: 5. An extraordinary attestation of a civil servant may be conducted before the time specified in part 4 of this Article after a decision has been adopted under the established procedure:

moscow3-ucf7cd48b48f8963740-1.text: 1) to reduce the number of civil service positions in the state body;

moscow3-udb237b6e1fd64c76c7-1.text: 2) to change the conditions of civil servants' remuneration.

moscow3-ue0b2eb1bc24b2a9cab-1.text: 6. By agreement of the parties to the service contract, an extraordinary appraisal of the civil servant may also be conducted, taking account of the results of the annual report on professional service activities prepared in accordance with the official duties regulations. Before approval of the official duties regulations, an extraordinary appraisal is conducted taking account of the results of the civil servant’s professional service activities as determined by the employer’s representative.

moscow3-u8ef141da4a1465cc46-1.text: 7. Appraisal takes account of the civil servant’s observance of restrictions, absence of violations of prohibitions, and fulfilment of requirements for official conduct and obligations established by federal law.

moscow3-uefdbe101341409db78-1.text: 8. A civil servant on maternity leave or leave to care for a child until the child reaches three years of age shall undergo attestation no earlier than one year after returning from leave.

moscow3-u95e46af32743bbc233-1.text: 9. An appraisal commission is established by an act of the state body to appraise civil servants.

moscow3-ud8125fa3ac28475d4c-1.text: 10. The appraisal commission includes the employer’s representative and/or civil servants authorized by that representative (including from the subdivision responsible for state service and personnel matters and the subdivision in which the civil servant being appraised holds a position), as well as independent experts included in the commission in accordance with part 10.2 of Article 48 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’: representatives of scientific, educational and other organizations who are specialists in the relevant fields and types of civil servants’ professional service activities and in personnel technologies and civil service matters. Independent experts must constitute at least one quarter of all members of the appraisal commission. An independent expert’s term on the appraisal commission is determined in accordance with federal legislation.

moscow3-u5bb99413698daa762c-1.text: 10.1. In an executive authority of the City of Moscow at which a public council has been established in accordance with a legal act of the City of Moscow, the appraisal commission includes representatives of that public council in addition to the persons specified in part 10 of this Article. Those representatives and independent experts together must constitute at least one quarter of all members of the appraisal commission.

moscow3-uf98bf660dcc0663df0-1.text: 11. For the appraisal of civil servants holding positions whose official duties involve the use of state secrets, the appraisal commission is formed taking account of the provisions of the legislation of the Russian Federation on state secrets.

moscow3-u229098955525476ad6-1.text: 12. The appraisal commission is formed so as to exclude the possibility of a conflict of interest capable of influencing decisions taken by the commission.

moscow3-ueeaac884b79d9135b7-1.text: 13. While a civil servant who is a member of the attestation commission is undergoing attestation, their membership of the commission shall be suspended.

moscow3-u77d04f7b58b5129c1b-1.text: 14. If a civil servant fails to attend an appraisal without valid reasons or refuses to undergo appraisal, the civil servant is subject to disciplinary liability in accordance with federal law and Article 46 of this Law, and the appraisal is postponed.

moscow3-ue78d2770951641ce06-1.text: 15. Following a civil servant's attestation, the attestation commission shall adopt one of the following decisions:

moscow3-ua5e73bc3500662fe74-1.text: 1) suitable for the civil service position held;

moscow3-u2a23810259400907cf-1.text: 2) suitable for the civil service position held and recommended for inclusion in the personnel reserve to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement;

moscow3-u99b6a3b9d69bc95018-1.text: 3) suitable for the civil service position held, subject to successful completion of additional professional education; 4) unsuitable for the civil service position held.

moscow3-u6404aea0165d5d3af3-1.text: 16. Within one month after the appraisal, on the basis of its results, an act of the state body is issued stating that the civil servant:

moscow3-u7f9c0b1e7eea8f463f-1.text: 1) is to be included in the personnel reserve to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement;

moscow3-u8534ebb2b6b1e4d00d-1.text: 2) is to be sent for further professional education;

moscow3-ue745d5032c92f7a99c-1.text: 3) is to be demoted in civil service and removed from the personnel reserve if included in it.

moscow3-u740321faf59d95062b-1.text: 17. If a civil servant refuses additional professional education or transfer to another civil service position, the employer’s representative may release the civil servant from the position held and dismiss them from the civil service in accordance with the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.

moscow3-u0495fd1459cb96856d-1.text: 18. A civil servant may challenge the appraisal results in accordance with federal laws.

moscow3-u689ce411309a6961e3-1.locator: Article 38. Qualification examination (Repealed with effect from 29 April 2023 by Law of the City of Moscow of 19 April 2023 No. 10.)

moscow3-u38df3504aec5e7de03-1.text: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant
moscow3-u38df3504aec5e7de03-1.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant

moscow3-u30060b9c5673745ee2-1.text: 1. A civil servant’s professional service activities are remunerated in the form of monetary remuneration, which is the principal means of their financial support and of incentivizing professional service activities in the civil service position held.
moscow3-u30060b9c5673745ee2-1.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant

moscow3-udaa24def13ae693bf0-1.text: 2. A civil servant’s monetary remuneration consists of the monthly salary corresponding to the civil service position held (hereinafter referred to as the position salary) and the monthly salary corresponding to the civil service class rank conferred (hereinafter referred to as the class-rank salary), which together constitute the civil servant’s monthly remuneration salary (hereinafter referred to as the remuneration salary), as well as monthly and other additional payments (hereinafter referred to as additional payments).
moscow3-udaa24def13ae693bf0-1.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant

moscow3-u7c49e56b86ebf6c471-1.text: 3. The amounts of civil servants’ position salaries and class-rank salaries are established by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow.
moscow3-u7c49e56b86ebf6c471-1.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant

moscow3-u2fc1b70fb58b172118-1.text: 4. Additional payments include: 1) a monthly allowance to the position salary for length of civil service, in the following amounts:
moscow3-u2fc1b70fb58b172118-1.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant

moscow3-u58c5b77a4cf55b1b51-1.text: Length of civil service | percentage: from 1 year to 5 years | 10; from 5 to 10 years | 15; from 10 to 15 years | 20; over 15 years | 30. 2) a monthly allowance to the position salary for special civil service conditions of up to 200 percent of that salary; 3) a monthly percentage allowance to the position salary for work with state secrets, in the amounts and according to the procedure established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts;
moscow3-u58c5b77a4cf55b1b51-1.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant

moscow3-uc9152a3554c0078379-1.text: 4) bonuses for performing particularly important and complex tasks, taking account of support for the state body’s tasks and functions and compliance with the official duties regulations (no maximum amount is set);
moscow3-uc9152a3554c0078379-1.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant

moscow3-u4f2be7652fc1694a09-1.text: 5) monthly monetary incentives; 6) a lump-sum payment upon the granting of annual paid leave and material assistance, paid from the state body’s civil servants’ remuneration fund.
moscow3-u4f2be7652fc1694a09-1.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant

moscow3-u95d1dadd97ccb1d606-1.text: 5. The procedure and conditions for bonuses for performing particularly important and complex tasks, payment of the monthly allowance to the position salary for special civil service conditions, and the lump-sum payment upon the granting of annual paid leave and material assistance from the state body’s civil servants’ remuneration fund are determined by the employer’s representative.
moscow3-u95d1dadd97ccb1d606-1.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant

moscow3-u8716576e474c6c872c-1.text: 6. The amounts of monthly monetary incentives paid to civil servants are established by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow when determining the funds allocated for those purposes in forming the state body’s civil servants’ remuneration fund.
moscow3-u8716576e474c6c872c-1.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant

moscow3-u22a5fd343cc03c03e2-1.text: 7. Remuneration salaries for civil service positions are increased (indexed) annually in accordance with the City of Moscow law on the budget of the City of Moscow for the relevant year, taking account of inflation (consumer prices). Increases (indexation) within the funds provided for by the City of Moscow law on the budget of the City of Moscow are made in accordance with the procedure and time limits established by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow.
moscow3-u22a5fd343cc03c03e2-1.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant

moscow3-u7e26c2485a4f3e13be-1.text: 8. Civil servants receive other payments provided for by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts and by laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow.
moscow3-u7e26c2485a4f3e13be-1.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant

moscow3-ua62e1e3fbc1b84be1a-1.text: 9. In cases provided for by federal law, civil servants may also receive monetary remuneration from the federal budget.
moscow3-ua62e1e3fbc1b84be1a-1.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant

moscow3-u9754d3b6ca6a721ac9-1.text: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund
moscow3-u9754d3b6ca6a721ac9-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund

moscow3-u6172d493839603a673-1.text: 1. The remuneration fund for civil servants and employees of a state body consists of the civil servants’ remuneration fund and the remuneration fund for employees holding positions that are not civil service positions.
moscow3-u6172d493839603a673-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund

moscow3-uf6d1401682873e5507-1.text: 2. When forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund, the following funds are provided, in addition to the funds allocated for position salaries, for the following payments (calculated per year):
moscow3-uf6d1401682873e5507-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund

moscow3-u316f4076ac8c9ccf6b-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund

moscow3-u7802be5eb62ca52cba-1.text: 2) the monthly allowance to the position salary for length of civil service — three position salaries;
moscow3-u7802be5eb62ca52cba-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund

moscow3-u56d33f9cd11ecd4d26-1.text: 3) the monthly allowance to the position salary for special civil service conditions — fourteen position salaries; 4) the monthly percentage allowance to the position salary for work with state secrets — one and a half position salaries;
moscow3-u56d33f9cd11ecd4d26-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund

moscow3-u9fd6507d0f23839831-1.text: 5) bonuses for performing particularly important and complex tasks — two remuneration salaries;
moscow3-u9fd6507d0f23839831-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund

moscow3-u84661123d5bc02fdf9-1.text: 6) monthly monetary incentives — in the amount established for civil servants by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow;
moscow3-u84661123d5bc02fdf9-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund

moscow3-ua07abec148721acdc0-1.text: 7) the lump-sum payment upon the granting of annual paid leave and material assistance — three remuneration salaries.
moscow3-ua07abec148721acdc0-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund

moscow3-ued2e9091808764b7cd-1.text: 3. The employer’s representative may redistribute funds from state bodies’ civil servants’ remuneration funds allocated for the respective payments among the payments provided for by part 2 of this Article.
moscow3-ued2e9091808764b7cd-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund

moscow3-u97bc9fef2fdcc84655-1.text: 4. The civil servants’ remuneration fund is formed in accordance with a decree of the Mayor of Moscow, taking account of this Article. The amount provided when forming that fund may not be less than the amount established by this Article.
moscow3-u97bc9fef2fdcc84655-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund

moscow3-ue30480df30cee6d517-1.text: 5. Other payments provided for civil servants by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts and by laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, which do not form part of monetary remuneration — including the basic and additional guarantees established by this Law and provided in monetary form — and the retention of average wages for a civil servant holding a position being reduced who is sent for additional professional education, are financed from the budget of the City of Moscow in addition to the duly approved remuneration fund for the state body’s civil servants and employees.
moscow3-ue30480df30cee6d517-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund

moscow3-u567bee3d62ce7622f8-1.text: Chapter 10. State guarantees in the civil service
moscow3-u567bee3d62ce7622f8-1.locator: Chapter 10. State guarantees in the civil service

moscow3-ucc61249b4bbcca0466-1.text: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
moscow3-ucc61249b4bbcca0466-1.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u8ee978ccb95f19fa31-1.text: 1. To ensure civil servants’ legal and social protection, increase their motivation to perform official duties effectively, strengthen the stability of the professional civil service workforce, and compensate for restrictions established by federal laws, civil servants are guaranteed:
moscow3-u8ee978ccb95f19fa31-1.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-uecc6d74a2220a08e00-1.text: 1) equal remuneration conditions and comparable indicators for assessing the efficiency of professional service results when holding corresponding civil service positions, unless otherwise established by federal law;
moscow3-uecc6d74a2220a08e00-1.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-udb215f322a20c2ecfb-1.text: 2) the right to receive monetary remuneration in full and on time;
moscow3-udb215f322a20c2ecfb-1.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u92e350e423028e8668-1.text: 3) civil service conditions that ensure the performance of official duties in accordance with the official duties regulations;
moscow3-u92e350e423028e8668-1.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u3086f7ef54eeb88466-1.text: 4) rest, ensured by normal service hours, days off and non-working public holidays, and annual paid basic and additional leave; 5) medical insurance for the civil servant and their family members in accordance with federal laws, including after the civil servant retires on a length-of-service pension;
moscow3-u3086f7ef54eeb88466-1.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-ufa77d7e11ac86a11f7-1.text: 6) compulsory state social insurance in accordance with federal laws against illness or incapacity for work during civil service, or retention of monetary remuneration during temporary incapacity for work and during examinations at a medical organization providing specialized medical care, in accordance with federal law;
moscow3-ufa77d7e11ac86a11f7-1.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u10add368663fe0351d-1.text: 7) payments under compulsory state insurance in the cases, in accordance with the procedure and in the amounts established by a law of the City of Moscow;
moscow3-u10add368663fe0351d-1.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u03d04e23bf300b4e6d-1.text: 8) reimbursement of expenses connected with official business trips. The procedure and conditions for sending a civil servant on official business trips are established by regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow;
moscow3-u03d04e23bf300b4e6d-1.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-ub9c18f936d35df97a3-1.text: 9) reimbursement of expenses connected with relocation of the civil servant and their family members to another locality when the civil servant is transferred, on the employer’s representative’s initiative, to another civil service position in the same or another state body. The procedure and conditions for reimbursement are established by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow;
moscow3-ub9c18f936d35df97a3-1.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u601d6743396ad05f8c-1.text: 10) protection of the civil servant and their family members against violence, threats and other unlawful acts connected with the performance of official duties, in the cases, in accordance with the procedure and on the conditions established by federal law;
moscow3-u601d6743396ad05f8c-1.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u85893d0f53b0f46341-1.text: 11) state pension provision under the procedure and conditions established by the federal law on state pension provision for citizens of the Russian Federation who have performed state service and their families.
moscow3-u85893d0f53b0f46341-1.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-ub8b68c98a858fcfd59-1.text: 2. Where a civil servant is released from the civil service position held because of election or appointment to a state office, election to an elected office in a local self-government body, or election (delegation) to a paid elected office in a trade union body, including an elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a state body, that civil servant’s pension provision conditions are determined according to their choice.
moscow3-ub8b68c98a858fcfd59-1.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u8b531402daa5a6efc5-1.text: 3. Civil servants shall also be provided with other state guarantees established by federal laws.
moscow3-u8b531402daa5a6efc5-1.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u29f4ad12c2f8489859-1.text: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
moscow3-u29f4ad12c2f8489859-1.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u5dc2108312e234e3d2-1.text: 1. Civil servants are provided with the following additional state guarantees:
moscow3-u5dc2108312e234e3d2-1.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-ucebb2d2b4e9d65d2db-1.text: 1) further professional education with retention of the civil service position held and monetary remuneration for that period;
moscow3-ucebb2d2b4e9d65d2db-1.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-ub599588226d57f0188-1.text: 2) transport services provided in connection with the performance of official duties, depending on the categories and groups of civil service positions held;
moscow3-ub599588226d57f0188-1.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u855a70c67b96e970eb-1.text: 3) compensation for the use of personal transport for service purposes and reimbursement of associated expenses, depending on the categories and groups of civil service positions held;
moscow3-u855a70c67b96e970eb-1.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u9b8cc7a14f1dd26c4a-1.text: 4) filling another civil service position upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body in accordance with Article 28 of this Law;
moscow3-u9b8cc7a14f1dd26c4a-1.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u2ab028cbbb127c9196-1.text: 5) a one-time subsidy for the purchase of residential premises, provided once during the entire period of civil service, in accordance with the procedure and conditions established by a regulatory legal act of the City of Moscow. Until the relevant regulatory legal act is adopted, civil servants are provided with residential premises depending on their civil service conditions, and are registered as needing improved housing conditions or compensated for housing purchase expenses; 6) a free or discounted sanatorium or health-resort voucher provided for annual paid leave, with corresponding reimbursement for travel to and from the place of rest, and discounted sanatorium or health-resort vouchers for family members, depending on the category and group of the civil service position held;
moscow3-u2ab028cbbb127c9196-1.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-ucd6f318746bd5301bc-1.text: 7) compensation for an unused sanatorium or health-resort voucher;
moscow3-ucd6f318746bd5301bc-1.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-uc70433c5da6e9b53f5-1.text: 8) medical care, including for family members, depending on the category and group of the civil service position held;
moscow3-uc70433c5da6e9b53f5-1.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u6998cd076920c77b0e-1.text: 9) free dispensing of all medicines on doctors’ prescriptions during outpatient treatment, free manufacture and repair of dental prostheses (except prostheses made of precious metals), and other prosthetic and orthopaedic assistance, including for family members depending on the category and group of the civil service position held, or corresponding monetary compensation;
moscow3-u6998cd076920c77b0e-1.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u26529abfe896485cf4-1.text: 10) a one-time monetary incentive upon reaching the age of 50 and every five years thereafter, in an amount not exceeding two months’ monetary remuneration for the civil service position held;
moscow3-u26529abfe896485cf4-1.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u392e762b0e38d6bb74-1.text: 11) a one-time monetary incentive upon reaching 20 years of civil service and every five years thereafter, in an amount not exceeding two months’ monetary remuneration for the civil service position held, provided the person has at least five years of civil service in state bodies and local self-government bodies;
moscow3-u392e762b0e38d6bb74-1.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u08d9de54b8a382f01f-1.text: 12) payment, once during the entire period of civil service, of a monetary reward upon retirement from civil service, calculated by multiplying the monthly monetary remuneration for the last civil service position held before termination of civil service by the number of full years of civil service, but counting no more than ten years as of the date of termination of civil service.
moscow3-u08d9de54b8a382f01f-1.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u8990a3ec64d9102338-1.text: For civil servants who previously received an analogous payment upon termination of federal military service, federal law-enforcement service, federal state civil service, state civil service of other constituent entities of the Russian Federation or municipal service in the Russian Federation, the payment is made in proportion to the number of full years of civil service in state bodies and local self-government bodies;
moscow3-u8990a3ec64d9102338-1.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants

moscow3-u2dbe7b2248c2bc9c45-1.text: 13) a monthly pension supplement established in addition to an old-age insurance pension or a disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disabilities, awarded in accordance with Federal Law of 28 December 2013 No. 400-ФЗ ‘On Insurance Pensions’ or awarded early in accordance with Federal Law of 12 December 2023 No. 565-ФЗ ‘On Employment of the Population in the Russian Federation’ (hereinafter referred to as the pension supplement). A pension supplement is established where the civil servant has a length of civil service whose minimum duration for the relevant year is determined in accordance with Appendix 2 to Federal Law of 15 December 2001 No. 166-ФЗ ‘On State Pension Provision in the Russian Federation’, in an amount such that the sum of the old-age insurance pension or the disability insurance pension for a person with a Group I or II disability and the pension supplement equals 55 percent of the civil servant’s monthly monetary remuneration for the last civil service position held before reaching the age specified in Appendix 5 to the Federal Law ‘On Insurance Pensions’ or before dismissal from the civil service. The pension supplement increases by three percent of the civil servant’s monthly monetary remuneration for each full year of service beyond the minimum length of civil service established by federal legislation for the relevant year; the sum of the old-age insurance pension or disability insurance pension for a person with a Group I or II disability and the pension supplement may not exceed 80 percent of the civil servant’s monthly monetary remuneration. The monthly monetary remuneration taken into account in calculating the pension supplement is established by the Mayor of Moscow. moscow3-u37ba802459c4a4af7e-1.text: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
moscow3-u37ba802459c4a4af7e-1.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

moscow3-ueb51ace89bcef4b00a-1.text: 1. Before imposing a disciplinary sanction, the employer's representative must request a written explanation from the civil servant. If the civil servant refuses to provide such an explanation, a corresponding statement shall be drawn up. A civil servant's refusal to provide a written explanation shall not prevent imposition of a disciplinary sanction.
moscow3-ueb51ace89bcef4b00a-1.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

moscow3-ub91d4ebdd8055631ec-1.text: 2. Before imposing a disciplinary sanction, the employer’s representative conducts an internal service inquiry.
moscow3-ub91d4ebdd8055631ec-1.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

moscow3-u2ed5833c88ade3f816-1.text: 3. When imposing a disciplinary sanction, the seriousness of the civil servant's disciplinary offence, degree of fault, the circumstances in which it was committed and the civil servant's previous performance of official duties shall be taken into account.
moscow3-u2ed5833c88ade3f816-1.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

moscow3-u63700cbcf995b35892-1.text: 4. A disciplinary sanction shall be imposed promptly after discovery of the disciplinary offence, but no later than one month from its discovery, excluding periods of the civil servant's temporary incapacity for work, leave, other absence from service for valid reasons, and the time taken by the internal service inquiry.
moscow3-u63700cbcf995b35892-1.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

moscow3-uc53e6d6b938b791f4e-1.text: 5. A disciplinary sanction may not be imposed later than six months after the disciplinary offence was committed, or, following an inspection of financial and economic activities or an audit, later than two years after it was committed. Time spent on criminal proceedings shall not be included in those periods.
moscow3-uc53e6d6b938b791f4e-1.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

moscow3-u127bcfb34b8afc7d38-1.text: 6. A copy of the state body’s act imposing a disciplinary sanction on a civil servant, specifying the grounds for the sanction, is delivered to the civil servant against a signed acknowledgement within five days of issuance of the relevant act.
moscow3-u127bcfb34b8afc7d38-1.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

moscow3-ub903b0a09a3f55e138-1.text: 7. A civil servant may challenge a disciplinary sanction in writing before the state body’s service disputes commission (hereinafter referred to as the service disputes commission) or a court.
moscow3-ub903b0a09a3f55e138-1.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

moscow3-ubb79d54b054817396d-1.text: 8. If, within one year of the imposition of a disciplinary sanction provided for by point 1, 2 or 3 of part 1 of Article 46 of this Law or a sanction provided for by point 1, 2 or 3 of part 3 of Article 46 of this Law, a civil servant is not subjected to a new disciplinary sanction, the civil servant is deemed to have no disciplinary sanction.
moscow3-ubb79d54b054817396d-1.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

moscow3-u48ff2f5dd128ce08eb-1.text: 9. The employer's representative may lift a civil servant's disciplinary sanction before one year has elapsed from its imposition, on their own initiative, on the civil servant's written application or on a request from the civil servant's immediate supervisor.
moscow3-u48ff2f5dd128ce08eb-1.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction

moscow3-u141838e645a946a468-1.text: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences
moscow3-u141838e645a946a468-1.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

moscow3-u55be8b8caf87490404-1.text: 1. The sanctions provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 46 of this Law are imposed by the employer’s representative on the basis of a report on the results of an investigation conducted by the subdivision for prevention of corruption and other offences within the relevant state body’s personnel service, or by an authorized subdivision of the Administration of the President of the Russian Federation in accordance with Article 13.4 of the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’; where the investigation report was referred to the conflict-of-interest resolution commission, its recommendation also serves as a basis. With the civil servant’s consent and provided that the civil servant admits committing the corruption offence, a sanction other than dismissal due to loss of trust may be imposed on the basis of a report by the subdivision for prevention of corruption and other offences within the relevant state body’s personnel service describing the factual circumstances of the corruption offence, and the civil servant’s written explanation.
moscow3-u55be8b8caf87490404-1.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

moscow3-u3b5174f71ac9618bc8-1.text: 2. When imposing the sanctions provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 46 of this Law, account is taken of the nature and seriousness of the civil servant’s corruption offence, the circumstances in which it was committed, the civil servant’s compliance with other restrictions and prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, fulfilment of duties established for the purpose of combating corruption, and previous performance of official duties.
moscow3-u3b5174f71ac9618bc8-1.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

moscow3-udbca72f88050dce52e-1.text: 3. The sanctions provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 46 of this Law are imposed no later than six months after receipt of information about the civil servant’s corruption offence, excluding periods of temporary incapacity for work, leave or other absence from service for valid reasons, and no later than three years after the offence was committed’, add the following sentence: ‘Time spent on criminal proceedings is not included in those periods.
moscow3-udbca72f88050dce52e-1.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

moscow3-ue1f81f404662abe322-1.text: 3.1. An admonition may be imposed on a civil servant where their corruption offence is insignificant.
moscow3-ue1f81f404662abe322-1.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

moscow3-uf357ac5c790bb95a57-1.text: 4. In an act imposing a sanction on a civil servant for a corruption offence, Article 59_1 or 59_2 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’ is specified as the ground for the sanction.
moscow3-uf357ac5c790bb95a57-1.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

moscow3-u8aea8ad6b7ed922102-1.text: 5. A copy of the act imposing a sanction on a civil servant, specifying the corruption offence and the regulatory legal acts whose provisions were breached, or of the act declining to impose such a sanction, stating the reasons, shall be delivered to the civil servant against signature within five days after the relevant act is issued.
moscow3-u8aea8ad6b7ed922102-1.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

moscow3-ua896b1bef85de2dbd5-1.text: 6. A civil servant may challenge a sanction in writing before the service disputes commission or a court.
moscow3-ua896b1bef85de2dbd5-1.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

moscow3-u7af713f17d65477187-1.text: 7. If, within one year of the imposition of a sanction, a civil servant has not been subjected to a disciplinary sanction provided for by point 1, 2 or 3 of part 1 of Article 46 of this Law, or a sanction provided for by point 1, 2 or 3 of part 3 of Article 46 of this Law, the civil servant is deemed to have no sanction.
moscow3-u7af713f17d65477187-1.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

moscow3-u9418f5a47d28ecee6b-1.text: 8. Information on the imposition on a civil servant of dismissal due to loss of trust for a corruption offence is entered by the state body in which the civil servant served into the register of persons dismissed due to loss of trust provided for by Article 15 of the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’.
moscow3-u9418f5a47d28ecee6b-1.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences

moscow3-u6b95126b88c2a24378-1.text: 1. An internal service inquiry shall be conducted by decision of the employer's representative or on a civil servant's written application.

moscow3-u43f79ecfe1eb61d3d4-1.text: 2. An internal service inquiry must establish fully, objectively and comprehensively:

moscow3-u2e9e204acd23207d47-1.text: 1) whether the civil servant committed a disciplinary offence;

moscow3-ueba981910fe3009b50-1.text: 3) the causes and conditions that contributed to the civil servant's disciplinary offence;

moscow3-u0e02885b31fd0df080-1.text: 4) the nature and extent of the harm caused by the civil servant as a result of the disciplinary offence;

moscow3-uacf52a7a3e9eee0a6c-1.text: 5) the circumstances forming the grounds for the civil servant's written application for an internal service inquiry.

moscow3-uabd6874d04b5fb3c2c-1.text: 3. The employer's representative who ordered the internal service inquiry shall monitor its timeliness and proper conduct.

moscow3-u7c22132aa73e42e51e-1.text: 4. The internal service inquiry is entrusted to the state body’s structural subdivision for state service and personnel matters, with the participation of its legal subdivision and elected trade union body and, where necessary, independent specialist experts.

moscow3-ub3f240ca33bbd19e1d-1.text: 5. A civil servant with a direct or indirect interest in the outcome of an internal service inquiry may not participate in it. In such cases, they shall submit a written application to the employer's representative who ordered the inquiry, requesting release from participation. If this requirement is not met, the results of the internal service inquiry shall be considered invalid.

moscow3-u41ff805912d8d3832f-1.text: 6. An internal service inquiry must be completed within no more than 60 calendar days from the decision to conduct it. Its duration may be extended to 90 calendar days by the persons who made that decision. Upon completion, the results shall be reported in a written conclusion to the employer's representative who ordered the inquiry.

moscow3-u4e2aee9f8ae9ff26d7-1.text: 7. A civil servant subject to an internal service inquiry may be temporarily suspended from the civil service position held for the duration of the inquiry, with retention of the monetary remuneration for that position during that period. Such temporary suspension shall be effected by the employer's representative who ordered the inquiry.

moscow3-uc62bda8cc6b763a5e8-1.text: 8. A civil servant subject to an internal service inquiry shall have the right to:

moscow3-uea2d0cd84168158219-1.text: 1) give oral or written explanations and submit statements, requests and other documents;

moscow3-u40f6dfd78c4132e18e-1.text: 2) appeal to the employer's representative who ordered the inquiry against decisions and actions (inaction) of the civil servants conducting it;

moscow3-ud3317cb4bee60b663c-1.text: 3) upon completion of the inquiry, examine the written conclusion and other materials relating to its results, unless this conflicts with requirements prohibiting disclosure of information constituting a state secret or another secret protected by federal law.

moscow3-u8abc72df6f7d3ccd34-1.text: 9. The written conclusion on the results of the internal service inquiry shall specify:

moscow3-u152ef6667517259cd1-1.text: 1) the facts and circumstances established by the inquiry;

moscow3-u2e3aa5450ff0cc70b9-1.text: 2) a proposal to impose or not to impose a disciplinary sanction on the civil servant.

moscow3-uff22a31e10b9a7ddc9-1.text: 10. The written conclusion on the results of the internal service inquiry is signed by the head of the state body’s structural subdivision for state service and personnel matters and the other participants in the inquiry, and is placed in the personnel file of the civil servant who was subject to the inquiry.

moscow3-u92a04a9a8122c4363f-1.text: Chapter 12. Staffing of the civil service
moscow3-u92a04a9a8122c4363f-1.locator: Chapter 12. Staffing of the civil service

moscow3-u2d209ec42ee1bc468c-1.text: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service
moscow3-u2d209ec42ee1bc468c-1.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service

moscow3-u06c0af5a8926082da2-1.text: 1. The civil service personnel complement of a state body shall be formed on the basis of the following principles:
moscow3-u06c0af5a8926082da2-1.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service

moscow3-u06412e724bcb872d9c-1.text: 1) appointment of civil servants to civil service positions taking account of the results of their professional service activities;
moscow3-u06412e724bcb872d9c-1.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service

moscow3-u21ecc0671305fa5dde-1.text: 2) improvement of civil servants' professional level.
moscow3-u21ecc0671305fa5dde-1.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service

moscow3-u0281cd6f2edfc1da8c-1.text: 2. Priority areas for forming the civil service personnel complement shall be:
moscow3-u0281cd6f2edfc1da8c-1.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service

moscow3-ue1eaac1cf751fe8fad-1.text: 1) training personnel for civil service and professional development of civil servants;
moscow3-ue1eaac1cf751fe8fad-1.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service

moscow3-u7e8845d3952f3a161a-1.text: 2) supporting civil servants’ career advancement on a competitive basis; 3) rotation of civil servants;
moscow3-u7e8845d3952f3a161a-1.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service

moscow3-ue7f392f4731c4cf251-1.text: 4) formation and effective use of the personnel reserve;
moscow3-ue7f392f4731c4cf251-1.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service

moscow3-ude91e7c92710b4771c-1.text: 5) assessment of civil servants' professional service activity results through attestation;
moscow3-ude91e7c92710b4771c-1.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service

moscow3-u976cf3ab1475ce9bb2-1.text: 6) use of modern personnel technologies upon entry into and during civil service.
moscow3-u976cf3ab1475ce9bb2-1.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service

moscow3-u1279ae74e887c5526d-1.text: 3. In accordance with federal legislation, regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow determine the civil service positions subject to rotation and regulate other matters concerning civil servant rotation.
moscow3-u1279ae74e887c5526d-1.locator: Article 49. Principles and priorities for staffing the civil service

moscow3-u5dc77ce55d9b17ffae-1.text: Article 50. Training personnel for the civil service
moscow3-u5dc77ce55d9b17ffae-1.locator: Article 50. Training personnel for the civil service

moscow3-u487c2017841b25f5ce-1.text: 1. Personnel for civil service are trained in vocational education organizations and higher education organizations in accordance with federal legislation.
moscow3-u487c2017841b25f5ce-1.locator: Article 50. Training personnel for the civil service

moscow3-ucb0f66372a52f980c3-1.text: 2. A targeted education agreement financed from funds provided for by the City of Moscow law on the budget of the City of Moscow, between a state body and a citizen undertaking to perform civil service for a specified period after graduation, is concluded on a competitive basis in accordance with the procedure established by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow.
moscow3-ucb0f66372a52f980c3-1.locator: Article 50. Training personnel for the civil service

moscow3-u51cc8b2888e4a1af7d-1.text: 3. Training of personnel for civil service is coordinated by the state service management body.
moscow3-u51cc8b2888e4a1af7d-1.locator: Article 50. Training personnel for the civil service

moscow3-u8e603f976a8c80db23-1.text: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant
moscow3-u8e603f976a8c80db23-1.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant

moscow3-ub387a12a6adc984494-1.text: 1. A civil servant's professional development shall aim to maintain and improve their professional level and shall include further professional education and other professional development activities.
moscow3-ub387a12a6adc984494-1.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant

moscow3-u683e83a06bf5a7d4af-1.text: 2. A civil servant's professional development shall take place throughout their entire period of civil service.
moscow3-u683e83a06bf5a7d4af-1.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant

moscow3-ud08a850a618a3cf016-1.text: 3. The grounds for sending a civil servant to participate in professional development activities are: 1) a decision of the employer’s representative;
moscow3-ud08a850a618a3cf016-1.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant

moscow3-ub661d9c09c917623cf-1.text: 2) the results of the civil servant's attestation;
moscow3-ub661d9c09c917623cf-1.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant

moscow3-u08ba4cbef2030129d6-1.text: 3) appointment of the civil servant to another civil service position in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 28 of this Law; 4) first appointment, by way of career advancement, to a position in the ‘managers’ category of the highest or principal group of civil service positions, or to a position in the ‘specialists’ category of the highest group;
moscow3-u08ba4cbef2030129d6-1.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant

moscow3-u3011c94cca276f2abe-1.text: 5) a citizen's first entry into civil service.
moscow3-u3011c94cca276f2abe-1.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant

moscow3-u47cfd40e3aa04b9111-1.text: 4. A civil servant’s professional development activities may be implemented: 1) through a state order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system for procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs;
moscow3-u47cfd40e3aa04b9111-1.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant

moscow3-u047e40edc982786c0d-1.text: 2) within a state assignment in accordance with the procedure established by regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow;
moscow3-u047e40edc982786c0d-1.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant

moscow3-u946ccd1f8d2b873190-1.text: 3) at the expense of the state body in which the civil servant holds a civil service position, in an organization delivering further professional education programmes selected under the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system for procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs.
moscow3-u946ccd1f8d2b873190-1.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant

moscow3-u1abb69c6115a87fa43-1.text: 5. A civil servant’s professional development activities may be carried out outside the territory of the Russian Federation on the basis of a state order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ additional professional education.
moscow3-u1abb69c6115a87fa43-1.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant

moscow3-u0ece1601d6f7ef97bc-1.text: 6. A civil servant's professional development activities shall take place with or without release from civil service duties.
moscow3-u0ece1601d6f7ef97bc-1.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant

moscow3-u693c05c541cc2dcbaa-1.text: 7. The employer's representative, educational organization, state body or other organization shall create conditions for the professional development of a civil servant participating in professional development activities.
moscow3-u693c05c541cc2dcbaa-1.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant

moscow3-u670a0f19619b8cde8c-1.text: 8. A civil servant's further professional education shall include professional retraining and advanced training.
moscow3-u670a0f19619b8cde8c-1.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant

moscow3-u93f7804f8068fa52e3-1.text: 9. A civil servant’s additional professional education is provided by organizations delivering additional professional programmes, including on the basis of a state educational certificate for a civil servant’s additional professional education.
moscow3-u93f7804f8068fa52e3-1.locator: Article 51. Professional development of a civil servant

moscow3-u8bb9666a01f4a2616a-1.text: Article 52. State order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities
moscow3-u8bb9666a01f4a2616a-1.locator: Article 52. State order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities

moscow3-ufbd7f1b7fd546206bf-1.text: 1. The state order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities for the next year includes:
moscow3-ufbd7f1b7fd546206bf-1.locator: Article 52. State order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities

moscow3-u473b6e954a8e31d72e-1.text: 1) the state order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ additional professional education; 2) the state order of the City of Moscow for other civil servants’ professional development activities.
moscow3-u473b6e954a8e31d72e-1.locator: Article 52. State order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities

moscow3-u73879b91317afc39df-1.text: 2. The state order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities is drawn up by the state service management body on the basis of applications from state bodies, taking account of their functions and specialization, and the professional education associated with the civil service positions held in those bodies.
moscow3-u73879b91317afc39df-1.locator: Article 52. State order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities

moscow3-u743885c16171d2f4ca-1.text: 3. The state order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities, including its volume and structure, is approved by a law or other regulatory legal act of the City of Moscow, taking account of this Article.
moscow3-u743885c16171d2f4ca-1.locator: Article 52. State order of the City of Moscow for civil servants’ professional development activities

moscow3-ucdccdcd1d098173921-1.text: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service
moscow3-ucdccdcd1d098173921-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-u3e9af195c96b543f9f-1.text: 1. To fill vacant civil service positions, a personnel reserve of the City of Moscow and personnel reserves of state bodies are formed from civil servants and citizens.
moscow3-u3e9af195c96b543f9f-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-u05bc9e654313af5a97-1.text: 2. The personnel reserve of the City of Moscow is formed by the state service management body to fill civil service positions in the highest, principal and leading groups, from civil servants and citizens included in the personnel reserves of state bodies.
moscow3-u05bc9e654313af5a97-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-ua6820d9d6d33135376-1.text: 3. A state body’s personnel reserve is formed by the employer’s representative.
moscow3-ua6820d9d6d33135376-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-uc6c5cbb9e442fc3082-1.text: 4. Civil servants and citizens shall be included in a state body's personnel reserve with an indication of the group of civil service positions to which they may be appointed.
moscow3-uc6c5cbb9e442fc3082-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-uf192b6d1f85cf77612-1.text: 5. Inclusion in a state body's personnel reserve shall take place:
moscow3-uf192b6d1f85cf77612-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-u960ef8cad79841f031-1.text: 1) for citizens, on the basis of a competition for inclusion in the state body's personnel reserve;
moscow3-u960ef8cad79841f031-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-uea5c09925fb58c9987-1.text: 2) for citizens, on the basis of a competition to fill a vacant civil service position, with their consent;
moscow3-uea5c09925fb58c9987-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-u539aacf09d8a1b60be-1.text: 3) for civil servants to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement, on the basis of a competition for inclusion in the state body's personnel reserve;
moscow3-u539aacf09d8a1b60be-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-u0075350cec5eeb2f9d-1.text: 4) for civil servants to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement, on the basis of a competition to fill a vacant civil service position, with their consent;
moscow3-u0075350cec5eeb2f9d-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-u6e809dbe4c6807811f-1.text: 5) for civil servants to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement — on the basis of appraisal results in accordance with point 1 of part 16 of Article 37 of this Law, with the consent of those civil servants;
moscow3-u6e809dbe4c6807811f-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-u5b4f759f52cb0d972d-1.text: 6) for civil servants dismissed because of a reduction of civil service positions in accordance with point 8_2 of part 1 of Article 37 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, or abolition of a state body in accordance with point 8_3 of part 1 of Article 37 of that Federal Law — by decision of the employer’s representative of the state body reducing positions or the state body receiving the functions of the abolished body, with those civil servants’ consent; 7) for civil servants dismissed on the grounds provided for by part 1 of Article 39 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, with those civil servants’ consent;
moscow3-u5b4f759f52cb0d972d-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-uf2cf7976350eb25d2b-1.text: 8) for civil servants dismissed because transfer under points 3-5, 9 and 12-14 of part 5 of Article 25 of this Law is impossible owing to the absence of another civil service position, or because they refuse transfer to another position under Article 25 of this Law — by decision of the employer’s representative with those civil servants’ consent.
moscow3-uf2cf7976350eb25d2b-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-u00b30f54aaab284f7f-1.text: 6. Civil servants are included in a state body’s personnel reserve in accordance with points 6-8 of part 5 of this Article to fill civil service positions in the same group as their last civil service position.
moscow3-u00b30f54aaab284f7f-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-u80dc20504576477687-1.text: 7. A competition for inclusion in a state body's personnel reserve shall be conducted by that body's competition commission.
moscow3-u80dc20504576477687-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-uf25f8f78919862551a-1.text: 8. Inclusion of a civil servant or citizen in the personnel reserve of the City of Moscow is formalized by a legal act of the state service management body; inclusion in a state body’s personnel reserve is formalized by a legal act of that state body.
moscow3-uf25f8f78919862551a-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-u45c828d0438d5f011b-1.text: 9. A civil servant or citizen in the personnel reserve shall be appointed to a vacant civil service position with their consent by decision of the employer's representative.
moscow3-u45c828d0438d5f011b-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-u7a55312c9a6f3f8544-1.text: 10. The regulation on the civil service personnel reserve, establishing the procedure for forming and working with the personnel reserve of the City of Moscow and state bodies’ personnel reserves, is approved by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow.
moscow3-u7a55312c9a6f3f8544-1.locator: Article 53. Personnel reserve in the civil service

moscow3-ub7e96805246ed8a362-1.text: Chapter 13. Financing of the civil service. Development of the civil service
moscow3-ub7e96805246ed8a362-1.locator: Chapter 13. Financing of the civil service. Development of the civil service

moscow3-ud2a5b78dd614c2f193-1.text: Article 54. Financing of the civil service
moscow3-ud2a5b78dd614c2f193-1.locator: Article 54. Financing of the civil service

moscow3-u4780f478df5ae20064-1.text: Civil ‘service is financed from the budget of the City of Moscow in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and by laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow.
moscow3-u4780f478df5ae20064-1.locator: Article 54. Financing of the civil service

moscow3-u4dd9f8e92adef07a36-1.text: Article 55. Development of the civil service
moscow3-u4dd9f8e92adef07a36-1.locator: Article 55. Development of the civil service

moscow3-ue5fd085e2d7f6f3076-1.text: 2. Experiments applying new approaches to the organization of civil service and support for civil servants’ activities (hereinafter referred to as experiments) may be conducted in a state body, an autonomous structural subdivision of that body, or several state bodies.
moscow3-ue5fd085e2d7f6f3076-1.locator: Article 55. Development of the civil service

moscow3-ub22738f3de60bd3649-1.text: 3. The procedure for organizing experiments aimed at developing the civil service and the requirements for conducting them are established by regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, taking account of the conditions provided for by part 4 of Article 66 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
moscow3-ub22738f3de60bd3649-1.locator: Article 55. Development of the civil service

moscow3-u0983538d30b0520b83-1.text: Chapter 14. Administration of the state service
moscow3-u0983538d30b0520b83-1.locator: Chapter 14. Administration of the state service

moscow3-u6af63bbe2a9adbb03b-1.text: 1. Overall direction and coordination of the civil service of the City of Moscow are exercised by the Mayor of Moscow.

moscow3-u75e9556c412d984bff-1.text: 2. The state service management body is established for the purposes of:

moscow3-ud251a28fafd95b5ec7-1.text: 1) developing proposals for personnel policy in state bodies of the City of Moscow and monitoring its implementation;

moscow3-u502756f93d6fa7e801-1.text: 2) coordinating the activities of state bodies in matters of entry into civil service, formation of the personnel reserve, performance and termination of civil service, use of the personnel reserve, and training and professional education of civil servants, and monitoring state bodies’ compliance with civil service legislation.

moscow3-u0ae17a292299bc3a9e-1.text: 3) preparing and submitting, in the prescribed manner, proposals for implementing civil service legislation;

moscow3-u37efaf103a7a35f101-1.text: 4) supporting the work of the conflict-of-interest resolution commission established in the state service management body, participating in the work of analogous commissions established in state bodies, and participating in commissions conducting competitions to fill civil service positions and appraisals of civil servants;

moscow3-u4267b2332ec3b743e9-1.text: 5) determining periods of service (work) included in length of civil service;

moscow3-u6bbc40cbdb6ba2bc18-1.text: 6) preparing explanations and recommendations for state bodies on civil service matters.

moscow3-u90557be6673e0ea9c2-1.text: Article 57. Liability for violations of civil service legislation
moscow3-u90557be6673e0ea9c2-1.locator: Article 57. Liability for violations of civil service legislation

moscow3-u3e3d8024de2b403da2-1.text: Persons responsible for violating the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation are held liable in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws.
moscow3-u3e3d8024de2b403da2-1.locator: Article 57. Liability for violations of civil service legislation

moscow3-u5f89f3121eb0e613e4-1.text: Chapter 15. Consideration of individual service disputes
moscow3-u5f89f3121eb0e613e4-1.locator: Chapter 15. Consideration of individual service disputes

moscow3-u0758da4e7bda769ddf-1.text: An individual service dispute means unresolved disagreements between the employer's representative and a civil servant, or a citizen entering or formerly in civil service, concerning the application of laws, other regulatory legal acts on civil service or the service contract, which have been submitted to a body for consideration of individual service disputes.

moscow3-u1c68d12f64463c8eaf-1.text: Article 59. Bodies for the consideration of individual service disputes
moscow3-u1c68d12f64463c8eaf-1.locator: Article 59. Bodies for the consideration of individual service disputes

moscow3-u2c0af045840713c878-1.text: 1. Individual service disputes (hereinafter service disputes) shall be considered by the following bodies for consideration of individual service disputes (hereinafter service dispute bodies):
moscow3-u2c0af045840713c878-1.locator: Article 59. Bodies for the consideration of individual service disputes

moscow3-u32cf1026480d4b9e34-1.text: 1) the service disputes commission; 2) a court.
moscow3-u32cf1026480d4b9e34-1.locator: Article 59. Bodies for the consideration of individual service disputes

moscow3-u0b5fa57ce68ec0992f-1.text: 2. The procedure for considering service disputes in service dispute bodies is regulated by federal laws.
moscow3-u0b5fa57ce68ec0992f-1.locator: Article 59. Bodies for the consideration of individual service disputes

moscow3-u4d1fd8cf8f03f819d7-1.text: 3. A service disputes commission is established by decision of the employer’s representative and consists of equal numbers of representatives appointed by the employer’s representative and civil servants’ representatives elected at a meeting (conference) of the state body’s civil servants, including a representative (representatives) of that state body’s elected trade union body (bodies).
moscow3-u4d1fd8cf8f03f819d7-1.locator: Article 59. Bodies for the consideration of individual service disputes

moscow3-u690cd4be4b69621448-1.text: 4. A meeting (conference) of the state body’s civil servants is held by decision of the employer’s representative, including in response to an application by civil servants or the state body’s elected trade union body. The procedure for holding the meeting (conference) and for the civil servants’ adoption of decisions is regulated by federal law.
moscow3-u690cd4be4b69621448-1.locator: Article 59. Bodies for the consideration of individual service disputes

moscow3-u0af8d43f4bbcc6a290-1.text: 5. The service disputes commission shall have its own seal. Organizational and technical support for its activities shall be provided by the state body.
moscow3-u0af8d43f4bbcc6a290-1.locator: Article 59. Bodies for the consideration of individual service disputes

moscow3-u525960aef94fb86a80-1.text: 6. A model regulation on the service disputes commission is approved by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow on the proposal of the state service management body.
moscow3-u525960aef94fb86a80-1.locator: Article 59. Bodies for the consideration of individual service disputes

moscow3-u78709272c03830a245-1.text: 7. The service disputes commission shall elect a chairperson and secretary from among its members.
moscow3-u78709272c03830a245-1.locator: Article 59. Bodies for the consideration of individual service disputes

moscow3-u473a6d28c3400b1ccc-1.text: 8. A service dispute shall be considered by the service disputes commission if the civil servant, acting independently or with a representative, has not resolved the disagreements through direct negotiations with the employer's representative.
moscow3-u473a6d28c3400b1ccc-1.locator: Article 59. Bodies for the consideration of individual service disputes

moscow3-u1c5960201e2da880c2-1.text: 9. A civil servant, or a citizen entering or formerly in civil service, may apply to the service disputes commission within three months from the day on which they learned or should have learned that their right had been violated.
moscow3-u1c5960201e2da880c2-1.locator: Article 59. Bodies for the consideration of individual service disputes

moscow3-ub1b2872b5f2d8adb9d-1.text: 10. If the period established by part 9 of this Article is missed for valid reasons, the service disputes commission may restore that period and consider the merits of the service dispute. A written application received from a civil servant or a citizen entering or formerly in the civil service must be registered by the commission on the day it is submitted.
moscow3-ub1b2872b5f2d8adb9d-1.locator: Article 59. Bodies for the consideration of individual service disputes

moscow3-u6c8c7e4a49ec6b790d-1.text: 11. The service disputes commission must consider a service dispute within 10 calendar days from submission of the written application by a civil servant or a citizen entering or formerly in the civil service.
moscow3-u6c8c7e4a49ec6b790d-1.locator: Article 59. Bodies for the consideration of individual service disputes

moscow3-u72e572e51e72c1e091-1.text: 12. The procedure for consideration of a service dispute by the service disputes commission is regulated by federal law.
