moscow3-u5449bd0dff9df24798-1.text: Article 60. Entry into force of this Law
moscow3-u5449bd0dff9df24798-1.locator: Article 60. Entry into force of this Law

moscow3-u7490025fc9eca31907-1.text: 1. This Law enters into force on 1 February 2005, except for part 8 of Article 6; point 2 of part 1 of Article 10 (insofar as it concerns familiarization with criteria for assessing the efficiency of performance of official duties and performance indicators for professional service activities); point 17 of part 1 of Article 10; point 4 of part 1 of Article 12; point 8 of part 2 of Article 20 (insofar as it concerns types and conditions of medical insurance); point 4 of part 3 of Article 20; Articles 36, 39 and 40; point 9 of part 1 of Article 42; and part 3 of Article 43.
moscow3-u7490025fc9eca31907-1.locator: Article 60. Entry into force of this Law

moscow3-u7d6b9f83eea01fd5d9-1.text: 2. Part 8 of Article 6 of this Law enters into force after a federal law or decree of the President of the Russian Federation determines the correspondence between federal state civil service positions and standard state civil service positions of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
moscow3-u7d6b9f83eea01fd5d9-1.locator: Article 60. Entry into force of this Law

moscow3-ucef4222123e045c267-1.text: 3. Point 2 of part 1 of Article 10 (insofar as it concerns familiarization with criteria for assessing the efficiency of performance of official duties and performance indicators for professional service activities), point 4 of part 3 of Article 20, and point 8 of part 2 of Article 36 of this Law enter into force after the President of the Russian Federation and the Government of the Russian Federation respectively approve general indicators, common to state bodies and civil servants, of the efficiency and effectiveness of state bodies’ activities, the adoption and implementation of managerial and other decisions, and the legal, organizational and documentary support for implementation of those decisions.
moscow3-ucef4222123e045c267-1.locator: Article 60. Entry into force of this Law

moscow3-u75a5c3fb1b8eca9708-1.text: 4. Point 17 of part 1 of Article 10 and point 8 of part 2 of Article 20 of this Law (insofar as the latter concerns types and conditions of medical insurance) enter into force after the federal law on medical insurance for state servants of the Russian Federation enters into force.
moscow3-u75a5c3fb1b8eca9708-1.locator: Article 60. Entry into force of this Law

moscow3-u8c7e52d64d5f8fa833-1.text: 5. Point 4 of part 1 of Article 12 of this Law enters into force after the authorized federal executive authority establishes the procedure for medical examinations, the list of diseases preventing entry into or performance of the civil service, and the form of the medical conclusion.
moscow3-u8c7e52d64d5f8fa833-1.locator: Article 60. Entry into force of this Law

moscow3-uf74e4b9c1305741337-2.text: 6. This part was repealed with effect from 17 October 2009 by Law of the City of Moscow of 16 September 2009 No. 34.
moscow3-uf74e4b9c1305741337-2.locator: Article 60. Entry into force of this Law

moscow3-u23375a6d9e8681167d-1.text: 7. Article 36 of this Law enters into force after the administrative regulations of the relevant state bodies are approved by acts of those bodies. The administrative regulations of the Staff Office of the Moscow City Duma are approved by an act of the Head of that Staff Office.
moscow3-u23375a6d9e8681167d-1.locator: Article 60. Entry into force of this Law

moscow3-ueeec23b047295b2d0c-1.text: 8. The provisions of Articles 39 and 40 of this Law enter into force in relation to civil servants after the relevant decrees of the Mayor of Moscow enter into force.
moscow3-ueeec23b047295b2d0c-1.locator: Article 60. Entry into force of this Law

moscow3-u93592faf7f6570eef5-1.text: 9. Point 9 of part 1 of Article 42 of this Law enters into force in relation to civil servants after the relevant decree of the Mayor of Moscow enters into force.
moscow3-u93592faf7f6570eef5-1.locator: Article 60. Entry into force of this Law

moscow3-u7b653b349a1d64927a-1.text: 10. Part 3 of Article 43 of this Law enters into force on the date of entry into force of the federal law on state pension provision for citizens of the Russian Federation who have performed state service and their families.
moscow3-u7b653b349a1d64927a-1.locator: Article 60. Entry into force of this Law

moscow3-u3eb28f6b31f1031b30-1.text: 11. Laws and regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow regulating the procedure and conditions for entry into, performance of and termination of the state service of the City of Moscow apply insofar as they do not conflict with civil service legislation.
moscow3-u3eb28f6b31f1031b30-1.locator: Article 60. Entry into force of this Law

moscow3-u4e7e6d310288184374-1.text: 1. Until the relevant decree of the Mayor of Moscow enters into force, a citizen entering the civil service and a civil servant submit information on income received, property owned that is subject to taxation, and property-related obligations using the form established for federal state civil servants. A copy of the income declaration is also submitted to the state body’s structural subdivision for state service and personnel matters.

moscow3-u4d7aa54d5e555e73a3-1.text: 2. The monetary remuneration payment conditions in force on the date this Law enters into force for state servants of the City of Moscow recognized as civil servants under this Law — including position salary amounts, established allowances and their payment conditions and procedure, and the procedure, conditions and amounts of additional state guarantees — remain applicable until the decrees of the Mayor of Moscow establishing civil servants’ monetary remuneration in accordance with this Law enter into force.

moscow3-uc26e454e1cd42bf870-1.text: 3. The amount of monetary remuneration established for civil servants under this Law may not be less than the amount established for state servants on the date this Law enters into force.

moscow3-u0bf26380be0cd526b5-1.text: 4. State servants of the City of Moscow recognized as civil servants under this Law are conferred the following class ranks by an act of the state body:

moscow3-u175edae29da9edc6ff-1.text: 1) holders of the class rank of the state service of the City of Moscow of the 1st, 2nd or 3rd class — Active State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, respectively;

moscow3-u28e8d7750af4689d62-1.text: 2) holders of the class rank of the state service of the City of Moscow of the 4th, 5th or 6th class — State Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, respectively;

moscow3-u7d886e61f7f2ee9147-1.text: 3) holders of the class rank of the state service of the City of Moscow of the 7th, 8th or 9th class — State Civil Service Councillor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, respectively; 4) holders of the class rank of the state service of the City of Moscow of the 10th, 11th or 12th class — State Civil Service Referent of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, respectively;

moscow3-ua841ea76f52681072b-1.text: 5) holders of the class rank of the state service of the City of Moscow of the 13th, 14th or 15th class — State Civil Service Secretary of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class, respectively.

moscow3-uf9ed21c07c25dbf1c0-1.text: 5. Periods of work (service) previously included (credited), in accordance with the established procedure, in length of state service are credited towards length of civil service for monthly allowances to the position salary for length of civil service, additional annual paid leave for length of service, civil service incentives, pension supplements and other calculations of length of civil service under this Law.

moscow3-u6541120bf9afdf12d6-1.text: 6. Until the federal law on medical insurance for state servants of the Russian Federation enters into force, civil servants and their family members, including after the civil servants retire on a length-of-service pension, including state servants recognized as civil servants under this Law, and retired state servants entitled to medical and sanatorium or health-resort services, retain the conditions of sanatorium or health-resort services and receive compensation for medical care in accordance with the procedure and conditions provided for by the relevant decree of the Mayor of Moscow.

moscow3-u9d389b535000c51987-1.text: 7. The procedure and conditions for establishing supplements to length-of-service pensions for civil servants and state servants recognized as civil servants under this Law are retained until the federal law on state pension provision for citizens of the Russian Federation who have performed state service and their families enters into force.

moscow3-u6761e9ef1736365796-1.text: 8. Until the state service management body provided for by Article 56 of this Law is established, its tasks and functions are performed by the Staff Office of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.

moscow3-u24dae884491474b689-1.text: 9. Provisions of this Law’s articles referring to relevant federal regulatory legal acts apply, until those acts enter into force, in accordance with the procedure established by this Law and the relevant decrees of the Mayor of Moscow.
